body:
Today, Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. is asking his supporters to join the new Grassroots Finance Committee, the people-powered movement to fund our campaign.

| [ ](https://www.kennedy24.com/?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=grassroots_finance_committee3&n=1)
---
Dear Peter, Today, Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. is asking his supporters to join the new Grassroots Finance Committee, the people-powered movement to fund our campaign. [](https://www.kennedy24.com/gfc?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=grassroots_finance_committee3&n=2) Too often, candidates look to corporate donors for funding. That’s how we get elected officials who sympathize more with corporate interests than the needs of everyday people. To end this corrupt merger of state and corporate power, we have to start by funding this campaign a different way. And we need your help to do that. The Grassroots Finance Committee is a truly grassroots fundraising model. Members commit to giving or raising $1,000 from your community. When you join, you will get a unique donation link on Kennedy24.com that you can use to drive donations. Will you join today? | [](https://www.kennedy24.com/gfc?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=grassroots_finance_committee3&n=3 "Join the Committee") [Join the Committee](https://www.kennedy24.com/gfc?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=grassroots_finance_committee3&n=3)
---
You can ask your friends, family, or neighbors to donate $5, $25, or $100. You can host a class or workshop for a suggested donation. You could do a hike and encourage people to donate for every mile walked. You can host a meet-up of Team Kennedy supporters for a suggested donation.
By joining the committee, you will get access to a whole network of supporters across the country. You will be invited to regional zoom calls where you will get updates from the campaign, meet other supporters in your region, and learn and share practices with each other.
Through this committee, we will not only raise the funds that we need to bring Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.’s message to voters across America, but also build the relationships and community that will strengthen the capacity of our movement.
All the best,
Team Kennedy

# I’m on the RNC’s Watch List
---
|
---
| | |
---
| Friends, This week I joined Mike Slater’s [Breitbart radio program](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=fadfb0d874&e=0be619cbaa) to discuss the RNC’s efforts to stop our growing campaign to restore America. We talked about the issues the RNC doesn’t want to talk about. We challenged them to do the right thing: open the debate to **ALL QUALIFYING CANDIDATES.** Mike, like you, understands that the American people deserve a candidate who’s willing to address the issues they care about. **_They want a choice, not a coronation._** Whether the GOP Establishment likes it or not, people are responding to our willingness to address the issues that are tearing our great country apart: the epidemic of fatherlessness, the failure of our education system, and the Soros District Attorney-led crime wave that’s destroying our great cities. [**The RNC is hoping we’ll go away. They put our campaign on their “terror watch list.” With your support, we can tell them that their terms are unacceptable, that We the People will not be silenced. Can I count on your support?**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=7fffedd636&e=0be619cbaa) My campaign is giving the DC establishment that runs the RNC some real heartburn. They want me to go home, but I’ve got news for them: **_I’m ramping up._** I’m touring the country talking to voters like you. I doubled down on my FTC complaint and launched a [national ad campaign ](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=e6961df963&e=0be619cbaa)challenging the RNC to abide by its rules for debate qualification. But I can’t do it alone. I’ve got a powerful political machine doing everything in its power to stop me from standing on that debate stage. That’s why I’m counting on voters like you. **_We need to get 50,000 unique donors, and we need to be at 3% in two national polls._** Given the RNC’s attacks against our campaign, we can’t just meet those numbers. We must exceed them. With your prayers, votes, and generosity, we can ensure that the American people have a real choice. We can let the RNC know that beating the Harris-Biden regime requires a bold agenda, and with one, we can take our country back. [**Will you give $20, $30, or even $50 to help us? A donation of any size takes us one step closer to that debate stage next week. Make your voice heard TODAY!**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=8c7140b873&e=0be619cbaa) Thanks,
Larry Elder
GOP Candidate for President
---
[**P.S. We all know that in politics, money talks. I’m not in the pocket of special interests, but I have the support of a citizen movement ready to take our country back. That’s why I’m counting on supporters like you to contribute ANY AMOUNT to show the Washington Elite that We the People won’t be ignored. ** ](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=398ab4da54&e=0be619cbaa)

subject: STOP BIG GOVERNMENT - REMEMBERING REAGAN SUNSET CRUISE
body:
A great opportunity to learn from President Reagan Ambassador on how to save our kids God-given unalienable rights! | | |
---
| |
---
| |
# Party of the Constitution
---
**Tyranny** is on the march, and the **God-given unalienable rights** of our kids and grandkids are in peril. This is not the first time America has faced such evil and the growth of big government.
Chairwoman Karmo proudly announces the "**REMEMBERING REAGAN SUNSET CRUISE** " with Dr. Alan Keyes, UN Ambassador during the Reagan administration, at Mackinac this year. Come listen to the stories about Ronald Reagan, who is considered an icon of the Conservative movement. He was a remarkable President of the modern era who possessed a unique blend of style, principles, and wit, capable of delivering a one-liner that could put a liberal in their place.
It's hard to forget some of the highlights of Ronald Reagan's political career, such as his well-known 1984 campaign ad titled "[It's Morning in America](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=2128d24e7d&e=a2af77507c)," or his memorable comment during a debate about not letting [age become a campaign issue](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=b1dc4fae67&e=a2af77507c), which even made his opponent, Mondale, laugh. Let's not forget about his notable speech for [Barry Goldwater in 1964](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=4aecead198&e=a2af77507c) or the numerous jokes he made about [Soviet Russia](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=79a287559e&e=a2af77507c).
One simple line caused the most change around the world. “Mr. President, tear down this wall.” This statement created a powerful image and had a lasting impact on America, Russia, and Europe.
At Mackinac, YOU have the opportunity to join an exclusive group of 14 individuals for a stunning sunset cruise to Mackinac Bridge and back, lasting approximately 60 minutes. This cruise will take place on the evening of Friday, September 22nd, and will include wine and hor D’ourves.
This event offers the opportunity to engage in discussions regarding the Reagan Agenda and find solutions you can use to help **save our kids and grandkids' God-given unalienable rights**.
| [PURCHASE REAGAN CRUISE TICKETS](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=1472efb28b&e=a2af77507c)

---
| | | | [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zkec5ddpgdstjg52ln9upnkqajkrhd1mk4mqv6u0_rp22sh2s8i66p75c9g60ob4c9h2bs)
---
| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

name: Sam Brown
subject: I looked in the mirror and had no idea who I was
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sam Brown for Nevada
body:
But it wasn’t because of my burns...

| | |
---
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zs2t8am6t12kn91dt5snf77ol9d2e9heac4d223g_rp22sh2s8i66p75c9g62o35c9h2bs)
---
Friend,

This is me in my ACU, or Army Combat Uniform, worn by Army soldiers as a utility uniform in combat zones.

It was the first thing I saw every day while I was deployed to Afghanistan...

It was a fabric that bound my fellow soldiers and me together...

It was a reminder of everything our brothers and sisters in arms were sacrificing...

**I always knew I belonged in a uniform. **

Then one day, God had other plans for me. I didn’t know If I’d ever put on a uniform again.

**[As I recovered over the course of three years following a roadside explosion in Afghanistan, I realized It wasn’t the burns on my body or the scars on my face that left me unrecognizable to myself...](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkn8s0ih5vt7c7gjrt0mhvcne9irg8g6in1jnhc8_rp22sh2s8i66p75c9g62o35c9h2bs)**
---
**[It was the realization that I had no idea WHO I WAS without my uniform. ](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zqf1okf4603bs2d2s9lp7lfp2n35abu7eob4ssog_rp22sh2s8i66p75c9g62o35c9h2bs)**
---
**[But Friend, with you on my mind I have never felt more purpose and clarity in this world! I know that with your help, we can win back this country.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zo2mf2qs4ohiqtgp14ff8jjt05ph7vfhb9b1mr60_rp22sh2s8i66p75c9g62o35c9h2bs)**
You see, I served my country because it was my calling. From a young age, I had made up my mind - I would wear a uniform just like my father.

But after my injury, I was _**LOST**_. That’s when a Lieutenant at the burn unit helped me find the man I thought I had lost within myself.

_Amy, my dietitian, made me realize that, no matter what I’d been through- I still had more to give to my country and to the American people. _

That was 14 years ago.

Since then, Amy and I got married.

I put myself through a Masters program in Business and Administration and went to work at an Amazon warehouse while I founded a company that cuts through federal bureaucracy to provide veterans necessary emergency pharmaceutical support.

**[And, in July of this year, I launched my campaign for Senate in Nevada. And I need your help now to take this mission to the next level!](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ze47pu6bsej73e2kto6bvnl67r0jk2l8l19s6vn0_rp22sh2s8i66p75c9g62o35c9h2bs)**
The one thing I’ve learned is that we don’t always know what paths God will take us on or what doors He will open or close.

But I am confident that THIS is where God wants me to continue my service to America and to YOU, Friend.

**[So would you consider chipping in a small donation today, if you’re able?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zq6drm0jslmmiu0pioesg748ehdk9ffm3kdnl73g_rp22sh2s8i66p75c9g62o35c9h2bs)**
Whether you donate or not, please know that I am going to do everything in my power to fight for your conservative values in the U.S. Senate when I’m elected.
Sincerely,

CPT Sam Brown
U.S. Army, Ret.

# FROM THE DESK OF NEWT GINGRICH
---
| | Dear Friend, **I'm pleased to share with you that The New York Sun is now carrying my exclusive weekly column.**

In it, I'll weigh in on the most pressing matters facing our country - and there are many.

**Under the Biden administration, our nation has lost its way.** Many politicians and major institutions are corrupt. Leading corporations are following their lead.

But it's the corruption of the media that has me most concerned. In my 70-year career in American politics, I've never seen it so bad. For this reason, I've chosen The New York Sun as a partner.

It's a paper that shines like a beacon amid a sea of lies and misinformation. It has done so for nearly 200 years.

**It's a patriotic paper that lives and breathes American values.** It places our Constitution front and center and has long been among its most valiant defenders.

It remains our nation's most effective counterweight to The New York Times, which has bizarrely claimed the title of "paper of record" but speaks for so few of our fellow citizens.

Now more than ever, the battle for the future of our nation starts with the restoration of real American journalism, and The New York Sun is devoted to that mission. It truly "shines for all."

But I know what the Sun is up against. All the cards are stacked against us.

To win, we need you to join us. To join The New York Sun is to join the movement to save America.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

subject: Cyril Focht Needs Your Help!
body:
Hello All,

I would first like to thank you all for your interest in helping to get Mr. Focht elected. Any and all help given is greatly appreciated.

I am reaching out to you all because we are starting fundraising cold calls next week and would like to know if any of you would be willing to participate. If you're interested, please email me and let me know what times you are available for training and making calls.

Thanks so much.

Sincerely,

Angel Monroe
Campaign Manager,
Focht for Tennessee
[www.vote4focht.us](http://www.vote4focht.us)

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

## Trump to Skip Debate, Speak to Union
Donald Trump intends to [skip the second GOP primary debate](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LtygzAQheGnEd0yYrkYChVp6Jw2JbNIi9lEIEYSJnn7jFOnPaf55v-4T3cSL_vjnTY2eQkT2SxPnvQAqAHrCQtnFmbkumBTdUOLFeq-KlbTDw3hjHpxPduuryqaebb1oi3Nt6HRhRjUWOsBtR7atu3Km2tsiwvZhpxjdKrR7CSHWH4G2fPKi_8JT46lDVvhzZrzkVT9pnBUOF7XVUY-M8f0-l9LiN4pHM-kcMzx3A5IX3LAzt8ZIh_n7MXSDo5nygwPeTKkg9muQGcOICmdnIDEMbykoAeoeoVjEY07LvFeUndTjX5sJP4Plf9v9BsAAP__bzNpwA) next week and travel instead to Detroit to give a speech to striking United Auto Workers. Trump, who has a commanding lead over other Republican candidates, says he's already focused on [the general election against President Biden](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtug0AQAL8GOqxl7wFbXJHGndOmRAu7Zy45HoKLrfx95NQpR1OMNB-34cYpp_X-zouGEreBp5IeOgA1CA2aAWsJURXV1BpaTw5bhL6t5zBqZALVbpwEabTE1EeHqkhOY2vrFBDQACEAOef8pRM7OYw8WRZRlMqCSirbcfnc0lpmjflne-hxmbalzmEuZT8r81bhtcIr76s-z5d6wVHSlLXCq2wrZ2nK8b3sjejIRZuzHOlLm9iRUgQZnfFkEXwPTmAUw-p9b7g-guzPlHM6fVdZuC-c8l-7_L_iNwAA__8CNF-R) and will use the Detroit trip to make a primetime speech in front of union workers. The GOP candidates who have [qualified for the debate](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFuhDAQAF9jOqNlMXAuXKShu7Qpkc0u3CaALewcyu-jS51upClG83Gf7l42OdZ3v7MrS5z8XOTJE1iNoLGdsCK3MCO3Fbumtx02CLemerghDMGbwS79jRhsoNYHD96CCaZtlq4Sh4AtWASwXdf19UBm7nDxs_FEjKQMMEmJZ_0Z5SgPXraf-OSznuNebe5RSsqqfVM4Khyv66rnkA--8ssrHF-ocCzn9550_pKU5Fh15jkepNeYNHHwhTVxOaMUhWN1OkqXbJvkflAG1t3L9lcr_8__BgAA__8d-106) so far include Vivek Ramaswamy, Nikki Haley, Chris Christie, Mike Pence, Ron DeSantis, and Tim Scott. Asa Hutchinson and Doug Burgum appear not to have qualified yet.
## Deion Sanders Decries Death Threats
Last Saturday's double-overtime Colorado-Colorado State game had college football fans on the edge of their seats, and the national attention increased after Colorado two-way star Hunter Travis was sent to the hospital by a [late hit](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGupCAUQL8GOwxeYJSCYhu62XZLc5XLyAYHgzdj_PvNvte--pzi5Px5zk_MJb9fv3Enz6nOuHL-0KycBCVBz9BFn4iAdEd-eDgLA6hp6DbvjJkoxcWOS5qc1mYZ1ZSG5JRFOyTssgcFWjlQyllrH_0YzWoh4WowRoIojKKYubb-b81v3iiVu36o9Wvdu-I35uMU-peAICBc19XTebz_QwFhraXQi2SqlRcsRUA4ubZbQJgFhBwFBD0ZrcHob702jFWejEzyKHhTkwn3XG7ZaKX8IRkJeZO8NUI-5Za5az4eVy4ln49RGPXaMZevOv551r8AAAD__ziqbHg) from CSU defensive back Henry Blackburn -- who's now receiving death threats. Colorado coach Deion Sanders [came to Blackburn's defense](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGvozAQhH8NdEZmwRAKimvocu2VaPGug--MHdmboPz7E695zetmRqOR5vtzX-_og4-P33jwLC6taMW_edWTAq2gW6Gm2TEDdzXP7TAZaEHf2nqfycEAbqKNNgPYaqOBwXS2H6eutWhrP4OGTk-g9WSMGZqRemvAoe2RiIGqXjN5Sbn5m3yUnV34pDfnxqajDvMu8ixV96uCpYLlPM-mPFMWHx-Rz3KVKlhepYIlWkTlUpINQ7g8n1dM7FNUBSNxLkoyvn1R-ysKZ2VTJD6iIkbZleyZUYraOeaP2gLaf9srR2VTSBkpfYsiKHxtt-ZmkfUIW29YozUOcTJQ55mepw_Bl2Gsev040IevQ_Iz3_8BAAD__60igFg), saying no football game should lead to death threats against a college student. At the same time, he said Travis, a dominant force on his team, would miss the next three games. Under Sanders, Colorado has become the hottest team in football. Their game with CSU was [ESPN's fifth most-watched game](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu8yAUBeCngQ3rcjF2GBj-hS3_2tEicLGpcIgMjdW3r9J27Pzp6Bydt-ty9bnk-_rf72R7qosPPT9pASMQBKoFebSJCElxsnIyGiXCRfLNKqnmi0kIwShzkypojcnM8TIpGMNN8WwRUIFBAKO1noY5jkFj8mH0MRJGNgLF3OsxvNd87xul8lmfdAyh7rzYrfdHY-ofQ8fQnec5tPwihi7UUmglhu5VwdCBYeik-aF6-FhFaB-C2uMuUk59E3ttXZy-h42i-M2LVGu_-VLE6ncS9KSDHzY-zlxKbtPMRlh3n8v3oP73P18BAAD__5DBZng) of all time. The team is 3-0 and plays the Oregon Ducks, also 3-0, on Saturday.
## Fall TV Season Arrives Without Shows
The network Fall TV premiere season is upon us, but the months-long actors' and writers' strikes have left the broadcast network with slim offerings. ABC announced that it would [simulcast 10 more games of Monday Night Football](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO4yAQQL_G7ohgABsXFNeky7VXWhiGeG6xiWCUKH-_ytZbPr3m6f27rbdAhc7733Cg51zXEJmeuMpFgBSgVxiTz4iAekSvpsWCAunUuPtN25AnzLNNUk8WFUajXXY24qxc1CN5kKDlAlIu1trpMicTLeQQTUgJIQ1GYiKu7fK_0sk75vKuT2yXWI-x-J350Qf9Z4DrANfwOPHVP-oDjSkWHOB61DOFtzjpvrPItfIWShFhi-LViLF1ESLX1kXnRl_YhdPRGps30FluGqRxdplUlsbNLqngxubT40WlUJ_mwcj7Eaj8FPHvg74DAAD__30gZwg) than originally planned because it has no programming. All three networks are leaning heavily on animation, reality TV, shows from overseas, and, in CBS's case, even repeating its popular "Yellowstone" series from the very first episode. It announced [its lineup of 40 new holiday movies](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FyhCAUQNGvgQ4HHiJSUKSx27QpHYTnQgKLI8RM_j6zqbe-xZn7cVtvLuX0uL-7grbvdXW-pwtXbhhwBnIFGuyOCCgpWjEZBQL4LGi0eg5azIFvWhkEo7wLuI0Stn2WiAJpssBBcgOcG6XUNOgwegW786MLASGQkWNIvZ7DZ02PHnHPv_XCc_C10Gxj70cj8o3AQmA5sB4Zn4nAEl3OxZ1f7CkwH8_UenGNlXolbKz5iOE7I9NGC8UNPW04flLOqU2ajPxeXMr_Sn89_RcAAP__w45YyQ) for the Christmas season, with the first debuting on Oct. 20.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

# My Husband Derrick Gates will giving the Invocation.
Looking forward to seeing everyone at the 2023 Republican of the Year Awards Gala on Saturday, September 23, 2023!
I'm thrilled to announce that Jennifer Horn, Co-Host of the "Morning Answer' on AM 870 Radio will be our Keynote Speaker!
More Good News..... We're having a Hawaiian Luau Buffet Dinner catered by Lisa's Bon Appétit featuring Beef Teriyaki, Island Chicken ( Freshly marinated in pineapple teriyaki sauce and grilled) and Maui Salmon ( Fresh filet of salmon rubbed in island spice and wrapped in banana leaves and steamed).
Plus: Pineapple Fried Rice + Hawaiian Potato Macaroni Salad + Romaine Mandarin Salad + Hawaiian Sweet Roll & Butter.
Dessert + Coffee + Ice Tea + Lemonade.
Ticket Price includes a glass of wine or beer . Be sure to mention TROY Awards Gala to family and friends while you're enjoying the Labor Day Weekend. Think about it, you could hit a homerun and meet your goal of selling 10 Tickets
Congrats to Russ Lesser who has already sold 3 tickets
Hopefully you have received the announcements that were sent for the Honorees. If not, click on the the Award Title or the Honoree Name below to see the announcement.
They will be Honoring

Hon. Bob Holmes

Chairman South Bay Lincoln Club
2023 Republican of the Year
Hon. John Cruikshank
Mayor Pro-Tem, City of Rancho Palos Verdes

September 20, 2023 For any not yet aware, there's video of ballots being illegally stuffed into a remote ballot box during the Bridgeport Democrat primary earlier this month. The scandal is being widely covered in CT, even by Hearst and other corporate media, because, though they try, it's hard to bury video of actual criminality taking place before our eyes. A full set of links to the video and press coverage appears at the end of this e-mail. A woman associated with the Ganim for Mayor campaign was recorded repeatedly stuffing multiple ballots into a ballot collection box right outside the Bridgeport government center building. CT state statute states that absentee ballots can be returned only by the ballot applicant, their family members, police officers, local election officials, or someone who is directly caring for a person who is ill or physically disabled. So, any video we ever see where a person is stuffing ballots into a collection box, would need to be a policeman or an election official. Any others caught on video stuffing multiple ballots into collection boxes at odd hours of the night are likely committing a crime. This ballot stuffer was caught on government surveillance video. The video was leaked to the press. And Joe Ganim's opponent in the primary, John Gomes, seized on the issue, for he only lost the election by 251 votes. Gomes is calling for an investigation, a halt to the certification of the election - and may call for a new primary. Bridgeport police will investigate the ballot tampering, and also made clear another top priority will be investigating how the video made its way from the security management system to the public so fast. Because, by quickly revealing what should have already been made public by election officials, someone has made it very inconvenient for the election to now be certified and the citizenry to again be rolled by the Bridgeport Democrat machine. The State Election Enforcement Commission (SEEC) said it will conduct a full investigation, and Governor Lamont, clutching his pearls, also called for an "aggressive" investigation, "leaving no stone unturned." Unfortunately, such electoral misbehavior is not news for Bridgeport residents. The woman caught on the video was also one of three Ganim campaign-aligned individuals who just last month were criminally referred by the SEEC to the State's Attorney, for the alleged misuse of absentee ballots back in the 2019 mayoral campaign. And law enforcement being what it is today in Democrat cities, she evidently was undeterred by her criminal referral, and was right back at it, a few weeks later. Complaints about ballot tampering and election irregularities in Bridgeport have regularly been reported for decades. Indeed, I was at the Blackham School in Bridgeport on Election Day in 2010 observing the vote, when in late afternoon the voting line stopped, and officials announced that they had run out of blank ballots. Then, before the promised additional supply could arrive from the Registrar's office, the line started moving again and voting recommenced. We never did get an explanation for the mysterious source of the replacement ballots. Tom Foley took the hit and Dan Malloy became the new governor. So, in addition to having to overcome Hearst Media's iron lock on Fairfield County's media, will we also have to face the prospect of continued absentee-ballot tampering? Ballot boxes scattered around cities and towns are unnecessary, (absentee ballots can be submitted by mail), and simply serve as an invitation, and facilitation for fraud. And Jim Himes continues to hold this CT-4 congressional seat largely on the electoral margin he perennially harvests from the Bridgeport polls. So, any video we ever see where a person is stuffing ballots into a collection box, would need to be a policeman or an election official. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Urge President Biden to permanently PROTECT Molok Luyuk – a unique ecosystem important to the Yocha Dehe Wintun Nation![Sign the petition now! ](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1996581?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** California’s Molok Luyuk, also known as Condor Ridge, is a landscape rich in biodiversity and cultural significance. Its rocky outcroppings and wildflower meadows aren’t just habitat for **30+ rare planet species, mountain lions, and Pacific fishers –** they're also of **deep importance to local Indigenous communities. ** This rare ecosystem is a **FREQUENT TARGET of greedy energy developers** , and as long as it remains unprotected, **Molok Luyuk is seriously threatened.[Friend, will you send a message asking President Biden to permanently protect this unique landscape before it falls into the wrong hands?](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1996582?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** ***Your Signature is Missing*** | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1996583?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
This currently unprotected landscape is central to the Yocah Dehe Wintun Nation’s origin stories. **The land details important history and culture for its people** and if approved, it would be only the second U.S. national monument to include tribal co-management.
Molok Luyuk also connects designated habitats for important species like elk and black bears. If it remains unprotected and developers disrupt this critical corridor, these **animals could face serious danger trying to cross from one section of their habitat into another. **
President Biden could protect Molok Luyuk for good, but we need your help to push him to act. [**Take just 30 seconds to help us reach our goal of 3,693 more signatures by midnight tonight. Add your name and help SAVE Molok Luyuk from greedy developers!**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1996584?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Fellow Patriot, We are suing the Deep State for interference in the 2022 midterm elections. America First Legal just filed a lawsuit against the FBI and Biden's Department of Justice for illegally concealing federal records related to the Biden administration's government-sponsored censorship and election interference during the midterm elections last year. **You may recall:** Matt Taibbi revealed in his The Twitter Files exposure that just two days before the 2022 midterms election, the FBI National Election Command Post (NECP) sent an email to the FBI San Francisco Field Office, flagging twenty-five accounts as election misinformation threats, including the Twitter account for Right Side Broadcasting Network, which regularly broadcasted former President Donald Trump's election rallies to millions of Americans. **Biden 's FBI was caught red handed!** _Since then, my team at America First Legal has demanded all FBI records related to the censorship of political speech and interference surrounding the midterms elections! _ **That 's why we are fighting in court right now: **America First Legal is suing the FBI and the DOJ for illegally concealing these records. Our aggressive lawsuit will also further expose how the FBI uses the false "misinformation" label as an excuse for censorship of the lawful speech of millions of Americans. **Censorship of political speech is morally wrong and it is a grave threat to our society. We will _expose and crush the censorship regime_ that has corrupted our elections process.** [**_But we need every patriotic American to stand with us and support our fight. name: David Hogg via Blue Amp Action
subject: Why I asked for your old furniture
body:
Leaders We Deserve is all-in on our mission to elect young leaders across America, so we’re going to spend as much of our budget on that mission as possible.
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5cffad74-9619-47d8-a37d-cae7a19ab564/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._
---
|
---
| |
---
| | | Hey, Peter, you may have seen me asking for your old furniture a few weeks ago: Well, I’m happy to announce that the Leaders We Deserve office is 100% volunteer-furnished thanks to the help of some incredibly kind supporters in the DC area! 🎉 What does this have to do with you? Keep reading ⬇️ [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tee76d4c0-a2b9-4f1e-9275-a7b09a6d95e0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) I asked for donations of old furniture because, to be honest, I didn’t want to spend your hard-earned dollars on fancy chairs or whatever. That’s not what we’re about. Leaders We Deserve is all-in on our mission to elect young leaders across America, so we’re going to spend as much of our budget on that mission as possible. And we’re proud to have Blue Amp Action's support in this mission. [Now that we’re all set on furniture, we’re focusing on growing our grassroots movement to elect more young people across the country. We’re still counting on your support, so will you split a donation between Leaders We Deserve and Blue Amp Action to help?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8225175c-2f4a-4810-a8cd-67ea3dec86b0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [CHIP IN NOW!](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te654150e-b46b-47f9-b333-6072166fe8f3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | This fight isn’t just about this election cycle. It’s about changing the face of our government forever by electing young leaders who are capable of bringing sorely needed change that will last for generations. By splitting a donation between Leaders We Deserve and Blue Amp Action today, you’re investing in this movement for the long haul. But in order for us to move the needle, this work depends on grassroots supporters like you. Whether it’s $5 or $50, every contribution counts. [Please consider splitting a donation between Leaders We Deserve and Blue Amp Action today to fund the hard work ahead of us (not to buy fancy office chairs).](https://default.salsalabs.org/T861caffe-0ed3-4be6-961f-72ae41492c74/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
|
---
| | | | | | [DONATE NOW](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4eb7cba6-03de-4f67-af13-44de35bf90be/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| More soon, David Hogg Co-Founder, Leaders We Deserve P.S. You might be wondering why I was wearing a suit moving furniture in 95F. The day we got to move in I had a meeting at the White House, so in the middle of my U-Hauling around D.C., I had to go to that meeting, and then continue moving our stuff up several stories. (I need to find a good dry cleaner in D.C.)

| | | About BlueAmp Action: We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Please follow Cliff Schecter on Twitter @cliffschecter, or subscribe to The Takedown with Cliff Schecter on YouTube, to keep up to date with this battle for the heart and soul of our country.

Peter -
My name is Aquilino Gonell, former U.S. Capitol Police Sergeant, and on January 6, 2021 I almost died defending the Capitol from insurrectionists inspired by far-right leaders like Sheriff Mark Lamb.
In April, Mark Lamb declared his candidacy for the U.S. Senate in Arizona against my friend Ruben Gallego.
I am writing because inciting, cheering, and making excuses for an attack on our democracy should not be a prerequisite or credential to be in Congress or any position of trusted authority.
But that is part of Mark Lamb’s claim to fame. It’s why he can credibly run for U.S. Senate against Ruben.
So I am personally writing to ask for your help. To help elect Ruben. To help send a message that we cannot allow insurrectionist-cheerleaders to get into the United States Senate.
So please:

body:
God saved my life on that one fateful day

| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zlqqqn3camtac3ujn1k7pph9spg22mgmrntnfrso_rp22sh2s8i66p75c9h69oj1c9h2bs)
---
| | You see, it happened in a split second, friend — when a roadside bomb detonated under the gas tank of my vehicle in Afghanistan. My body was instantly engulfed in flames. The pain was unimaginable. I thought my life was surely coming to an end, and I wondered how long it would be before I drew my last breath. But when one of my soldiers extinguished the flames on my body, I knew God had bigger plans for me.

name: Shamaine Daniels
subject: One of those days
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Dear Friend,
We've all had one of those days. A day where things don't seem to go quite, or a day where everything that happens, as aggravating as it might be, seems designed to remind us of something we already know. Recently, I had one of those days and it made it clear why we need better representation in Washington than Scott Perry.
Check out my recent letter to the editor published in the Patriot News/PennLive. After you do, if you agree that we need and deserve better, please make a contribution to support our campaign using the donate button below.
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-shamaine?refcode=TWemail1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-shamaine?refcode=TWemail1]
Recent news regarding Scott Perry and his role in Trump’s post-election insurrectionist circus has come as no surprise to his constituents in PA-10. Perry’s self-serving politics, punctuated by tantrum-like outbursts when anyone dares to call him out, have been his hallmark throughout his career.
In the wake of the 2020 election, Perry took it to a new level when he teamed up with Jim Jordan in an attempt to bully and terrorize Pennsylvania voters into giving up their voice to serve his own agenda. But through those actions, Perry showed voters in PA-10, and across the country, who he really is and who he has always been.
Either by the courts, the voters, or both, Scott Perry must be held accountable for his role in trying to overturn the election, but we need to remember that there is so much more for which he needs to answer. Scott Perry’s policies and agenda make life harder for regular people across the country, including those he was elected to represent in PA-10.
Like the rest of Perry’s constituents, I have to earn a living to support my family. I’m also a parent, who worries about my daughter’s future, and her safety and security here and now. Scott Perry does nothing to make life better or easier for the rest of us, and in many cases he makes life harder.
Recently, Perry’s abject failure to meet his obligations to all of us was driven home for me when, before heading off to a day of continuing legal education classes (CLEs), I dropped my daughter off at her daycare, only to be met by a man dressed in a security uniform outside of the Jewish daycare center. I didn’t know if the center received anti-Semitic threats from extremists and the hate groups that have been emboldened by Perry, or whether they had intel on a regular run-of-the mill mass shooting, which Scott Perry refuses to do anything about.
I remember feeling so relieved that this center, whose job it is to nurture young children, was prepared to handle anti-Semites and mass shooters - what a terrible thing in which to find relief!
My disappointment didn’t stop there that day. I went to my all-day CLE and during breaks, younger lawyers, like me, were scrambling to manage childcare. One attorney was splitting the day with his wife so he could take some credits and she could work, and they were trying to figure things out on a minute by minute basis. Affordable childcare is sparse in Central PA, leaving working families in the lurch again and again.
What has Scott Perry done to help working families needing childcare? Nothing. I imagine Perry doesn’t care about this problem because, as he is fond of reminding us, since he doesn’t plan to have any more kids, he just doesn’t care. So as we learn more and more about the ways in which the dangerous Stooges that support Trump were involved in one of America’s darkest moments, we can’t forget that he has a responsibility to serve his constituents as well.
Central Pennsylvania deserves better and we can only get better by electing candidates who understand what better means.
- Shamaine Daniels
Shamaine Daniels is a member of the Harrisburg City Council and a candidate for Congress from Pennsylvania’s 10th Congressional District.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/99379/images/PaidForByDanielsForCongressB.jpg]

body:
"I don't know his strategy. It's not clear to me what voter base he is intending to appeal to," said Citadel Founder Ken Griffin about DeSantis.

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/bc764eaecacb/breaking-ken-griffin-abandons-desantis?e=1cb5fdae9e)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20cb251164-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_20_12_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-20cb251164-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
