https://kasparlaw.co/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20cb251164-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_20_12_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-20cb251164-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
https://www.bestdental.org/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20cb251164-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_20_12_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-20cb251164-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Billionaire Ken Griffin Abandons DeSantis Campaign, Says "I Don't Know His Strategy," Will Watch Presidential Primary from the Sidelines Instead (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/09/billionaire-ken-griffin-abandons-desantis-campaign-says-i-dont-know-his-strategy-will-watch-presidential-primary-from-the-sidelines-instead.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20cb251164-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_20_12_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-20cb251164-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/09/billionaire-ken-griffin-abandons-desantis-campaign-says-i-dont-know-his-strategy-will-watch-presidential-primary-from-the-sidelines-instead.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20cb251164-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_20_12_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-20cb251164-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Ken Griffin, the founder and CEO of Citadel and Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis. (Source: E. Jason Wambsgans/Chicago Tribune/Tribune News Service via Getty Images; Anna Moneymaker/Getty Images)
By Illinois Review

Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis continues to struggle on the presidential campaign trail as former President Donald Trump widens his lead in the polls (https://news.yahoo.com/trump-holds-on-desantis-slips-3-new-polls-shine-light-on-republican-presidential-primary-race-190631741.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20cb251164-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_20_12_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-20cb251164-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) and solidifies his support with the grassroots-base of the party – leading many early DeSantis supporters – including billionaire Ken Griffin to question the strategy of the governor’s campaign and the “voter base” he’s trying – but failing to appeal too.

“I don’t know his strategy. It’s not clear to me what voter base he is intending to appeal to,” said Citadel founder Ken Griffin in a recent interview with
CNBC (https://www.cnbc.com/2023/09/18/billionaire-ken-griffin-former-desantis-donor-sits-out-gop-primary.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20cb251164-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_20_12_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-20cb251164-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) about the Florida governor’s campaign.

Griffin then concluded with, “I’m still on the sidelines as to who to support in this election cycle.”

But last Fall and Spring, Griffin was clear on who he would support for president – and that was Ron DeSantis.

Last November, Griffin granted an interview to
Politico (https://www.politico.com/news/2022/11/06/gop-megadonor-desantis-24-ken-griffin-00065274?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20cb251164-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_20_12_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-20cb251164-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) in an article titled, “GOP Megadonor: I’m ready to back DeSantis for president in ‘24,” where he said, “He has a tremendous record as governor of Florida, and our country would be well-served by him as president.”

Griffin is not the only billionaire megadonor to walk back their support of DeSantis’ presidential campaign.

Since the Florida governor’s rocky launch to his presidential campaign on Twitter last May that was plagued by glitches and audio issues, nearly half of his major donors have decided not to support his campaign – a big problem for a presidential candidate who many viewed last year as the presumptive frontrunner.

In a recent article in
Forbes (https://www.forbes.com/sites/saradorn/2023/09/06/desantis-wealthy-donors-flee-these-previous-billionaire-backers-arent-giving-to-his-presidential-campaign/?sh=633e7c566f19&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20cb251164-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_20_12_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-20cb251164-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , it was revealed that 24 out of 50 of DeSantis’ major donors have opted not to donate to his presidential campaign – creating a major issue for the man considered by many to be the future of the Republican party.

A recent national poll has Trump leading DeSantis by 47 points; and Trump leading Biden by 4 points – creating a nightmare scenario for Democrats and the often dazed and confused current Commander-in-Chief.
https://x.com/IAPolls2022/status/1702793345674744006?s=20&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20cb251164-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_20_12_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-20cb251164-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
President Trump is leading Governor DeSantis by 47 points in the latest polls.

But despite the DeSantis campaign falling further behind in the polls and major donors abandoning ship, some Illinois Republican Party officials (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/08/opinion-how-the-il-gop-has-turned-gov-ron-desantis-into-their-own-version-of-the-richard-irvin-campaign-for-governor.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20cb251164-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_20_12_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-20cb251164-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) – including Republican national committeeman Richard Porter and former gubernatorial candidate and state central committee member Jeanne Ives are still backing the Florida governor’s presidential campaign.

During a May 25th Facebook post, Porter wrote, “I am down in Miami helping DeSantis with his launch, and I am working the phones and emails to raise first day money for him — could you give today?”

https://www.facebook.com/RNCPORTER/posts/750786296757757?ref=embed_post&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20cb251164-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_20_12_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-20cb251164-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
During the 2022 primary, Porter was one of the architects of Aurora Mayor Richard Irvin’s failed campaign for governor – serving as “honorary” co-chairman (https://www.politico.com/f/?id=0000017e-6d5c-dbc8-a1ff-7d7dbf990000&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20cb251164-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_20_12_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-20cb251164-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) of Irvin’s campaign, where he remained a close advisor and confidante to the Aurora mayor. Irvin would lose to the grassroots candidate by 43 points.

In an interview at the Illinois GOP Day at the state fair in August, Porter spoke with the
Chicago Tribune (https://www.chicagotribune.com/politics/ct-illinois-republicans-state-fair-20230817-pycxzdra4jez7itg27nktvhv6m-story.html?lctg=443D14D13572C4AB7490B4ED9B&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_term=https%3a%2f%2fwww.chicagotribune.com%2fpolitics%2fct-illinois-republicans-state-fair-20230817-pycxzdra4jez7itg27nktvhv6m-story.html&utm_campaign=CT-Breaking-News&utm_content=alert&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20cb251164-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_20_12_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-20cb251164-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , where he sounded more like a Democrat than a Republican when discussing the candidacy of the 45th President of the United States.

“I think the most ardent Trumpers recognize that they might love him in their heart, but they know in their head he is not going to win independents in Georgia, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Michigan, New Hampshire, Arizona and Nevada. And that’s what you need to do to become president. And if you don’t become president of the United States, Trump goes to jail.”

After this publication published a story and included his remarks at the state fair, Porter was in damage control – issuing Illinois Review a very wordy and lengthy response that was
published in its entirety (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/08/il-gop-official-echoes-the-democrats-suggests-trump-is-running-for-president-to-avoid-jail-in-an-interview-during-gop-day-at-the-state-fair.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20cb251164-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_20_12_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-20cb251164-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) – trying to walk back his on-the-record comments to the Tribune.

State central committee member Jeanne Ives is also backing DeSantis – and during an interview in
Crain’s Chicago Business (https://www.chicagobusiness.com/greg-hinz-politics/illinois-republicans-2024-presidential-candidates?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20cb251164-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_20_12_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-20cb251164-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) on May 30th, Ives said and tweeted, “I’m a DeSantis fan...I like a strong governor with a proven record of accomplishments...Florida has, what, a $21 billion budget surplus...”

https://x.com/BreakthroughId1/status/1664025173777842181?s=20&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20cb251164-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_20_12_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-20cb251164-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

| | On September 14, I provided to the office of the Attorney General of Virginia a recommended draft bill to rid Virginia of child sex trafficking. A copy of the bill can be viewed on emordforva.com. Among its provisions, the bill will give the Attorney General’s office and the Sheriffs’ offices across the Commonwealth direct authority independent of the Commonwealth’s Attorneys to prosecute child sex abuse and trafficking cases. The bill also increases the criminal penalties for sex abuse and trafficking and gives the Governor authority to appoint specially trained sex trafficking law enforcement officers to operate within public schools for the purpose of receiving sex abuse complaints, reporting them directly to the AG, Governor, and law enforcement, investigating the complaints, arresting and expelling suspected traffickers, and relocating victims of trafficking from schools where they have been abused to other safe learningenvironments. The bill also requires that the proceeds and property acquired from sex trafficking be liquidated and supplied pro rata to the victims of sex trafficking. I have also written a tandem federal bill which I will introduce upon election to the U.S. Senate. That bill establishes the death penalty for child sex trafficking in instances where victims are kidnapped, die in the custody of traffickers, or suffer permanent bodily injury. It also heightens federal criminalpenalties for trafficking to include life imprisonment in addition to the death penalty. The bill requires each United States Attorney’s office to have a separate Assistant United States Attorney dedicated exclusively to the prosecution of sex trafficking cases and provides for proceeds from sex trafficking to be given to victims with a portion retained by the office of the AUSA who has achieved a conviction.

The three hour telethon reached over 2.5 million people across the nation. Jonathan and Sheryl also attended two fundraisers in Utah on the morning and evening of September 19. On September 20, Jonathan flew to San Diego and was joined there by agents of the CBP who gave him a tour of the precise locations where most fentanyl is smuggled into the United States. subject: We are closer to universal background checks than we’ve ever been

body:
#

Team, in case you missed it, we shared some big news last week:
**The Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) released a rule that would move us closer than ever to universal background checks.**
Currently, only licensed gun dealers are required to conduct background checks, leaving a gaping loophole that allows unlicensed firearm sellers to sell guns without background checks. This often happens online or at gun shows.
The ATF’s new rule would address this loophole and clarify when individuals are required to get a license and conduct background checks.
We are so proud that the ATF has taken this important step. For the past decade, universal background checks have been our top legislative priority here at GIFFORDS. We couldn’t have gotten to this point without all that you’ve done to support us. Thank you.
[**But there’s still more work to be done to reach a future with universal background checks for all gun sales in our country. So please, will you make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today to help us finish this critical fight?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep23.BeCgjV&refcode=em230920-1-60&t=1&akid=6555%2E3935704%2EDBzq12)

clean_body: Team, in case you missed it, we shared some big news last week: The Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) released a rule that would move us closer than ever to universal background checks. Currently, only licensed gun dealers are required to conduct background checks, leaving a gaping loophole that allows unlicensed firearm sellers to sell guns without background checks. This often happens online or at gun shows. The ATF’s new rule would address this loophole and clarify when individuals are required to get a license and conduct background checks. We are so proud that the ATF has taken this important step. For the past decade, universal background checks have been our top legislative priority here at GIFFORDS. | Hi team,

It’s Sarah here, Senior Campaign Advisor here at Scholten HQ. I wanted to update you on our upcoming FEC fundraising deadline on September 30th.

Every three months, we assess how much money we need to raise to make sure we can run a winning campaign in 2024. These totals are painstakingly calculated based on the fundraising numbers of our opponents, our staffing needs on the ground, and how much we will have to spend to get Hillary’s message out in this upcoming year. The current three-month period, the quarter, is ending soon, and we are falling a little behind.

The reality of running a robust campaign in a district as competitive as MI-03 is that you have to have a lot of money to win. With three Republican opponents, we have to raise more than ever to be ready to beat any of them. Whichever Republican candidate wins the primary will have the full backing of national Republican groups and, with them, a massive stack of cash to use to win.

On the other hand, Hillary's campaign will have her grassroots network's support to win. That’s why your contribution is so significant. We need to reach our goals to stay competitive, and being competitive is more expensive than ever as national Republican groups begin to invest later this cycle. Your support now helps us organize early to be ready for the year to come. [_**Will you please contribute today to get us back on track to reach this critical FEC deadline? ## **VIDEO TRANSCRIPT:**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/c9a5f75b-0dd2-4b3a-9c5a-740aaca42396?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
_**From Guantanamo to the ...White House? Why Warmonger John Bolton Loves Ron DeSantis**_
**Loomer:** Hey, everybody, welcome to a new episode of Loomer Unleashed. I'm your host, Laura Loomer. And on today's episode, we're going to talk about how if there's one thing that former Ambassador John Bolton loves more than starting foreign wars, it's Ron DeSantis. Now, you probably noticed this week that Ambassador Bolton decided to publicly attack Donald Trump, saying that by the time that the general election rolls around, he's going to be a convicted felon.
**Loomer:** Now, this isn't the first time that John Bolton has publicly sparred with President Donald Trump, and it's not the first time that he has tried to undermine Donald Trump's chances at reelection and has attacked his 2024 presidential bid. Earlier this year, as I have reported, if you've been following my Substack, John Bolton actually said that he thinks that Ron DeSantis would make a good president.
**Loomer:** And on top of that, he attacked Donald Trump as a loser.
**Loomer:** Along with publicly siding in support of Governor Ron DeSantis' 2024 presidential campaign prior to him actually announcing his official run for president, John Bolton publicly said on live national television that Donald Trump's campaign is poison to the GOP.
**Loomer:** Now, if you're just an everyday average American voter tuning into the news and you were to see John Bolton's comments attacking Donald Trump's campaign as poison to the GOP, you would probably not really know what the history of it was. subject: Don't be fooled, Gavin Newsom hasn't learned his lesson
body:
| | | [](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=6ca20956e20b4e3082aebaed0084f828&_e=UOUywO3wVrc7CdrBKDF-AL34aVzE8FkrxLEQVQrTrLswk5jG8tD6LgWQqFle-x7X8TLR30yuFjVZhSr5mgqz1Meho6wm0gMAopw12UMDbKGbj281pFRk1fOCl_ycQtNdiLHFxwJkJK3nyRUXRVFc0NM2Dh1DB_mlVYVmio9xp6TqfR_jxX2Eae34Vb4FilhpPx3BWd3Nd-HHmfKW3WjnTN_xhz1rs4lo2YXchj-EwDE%3D)
---
Dear Friend,
---
We see right through Gavin Newsom's pathetic attempt at revivsionist history. He has the gall to tell the American people, “I think all of us in terms of our collective wisdom, we’ve evolved. We didn’t know what we didn’t know. We’re experts in hindsight. We’re all geniuses now.” Even with all his newfound “wisdom,” I’m sure Newsom still doesn’t regret closing churches while letting bars and strip clubs stay open. We won't let him shirk responsibility for the disastrous results his tyrannical policies produced. He purposefully ignored a mass of us Californians who knew better at the time and told him so. Here's how I know California learned NOTHING from the pandemic: _the city of Los Angeles is **STILL** sending me fines for **worshiping Jesus OUTSIDE in 2020**!_ This fine is nothing more than government intimidation. Los Angeles is trying to remind us that they haven't forgotten about how we stood up for ourselves and our beliefs.
---
[](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=6ca20956e20b4e3082aebaed0084f828&_e=UOUywO3wVrc7CdrBKDF-AL34aVzE8FkrxLEQVQrTrLswk5jG8tD6LgWQqFle-x7X8TLR30yuFjVZhSr5mgqz1OzwRulrAsuV_FLFVX7bbsCe8p0gznbyAv6SnHkIQ73j00F2eVbJGSjq0Y4gZONtulHSkLy_peZ4YE1IXs2CqT8NhCtQ_8JE0jsRy3bf29JtOBZRt6SJx-3ko1UoMp0NiulPThq3UadDozIlptTDj30%3D)
---
I don’t remember them fining BLM or Antifa for gathering by the thousands and destroying entire city blocks! But they want to penalize peaceful worshipers! WAKE UP AMERICA!

We CANNOT just accept this kind of persecution lying down. Government persecution like this is EXACTLY how Let Us Worship was born!
---

| For the past few months, because of this grassroots team, I’ve been able to traverse the Golden State, meeting with folks from Sacramento to San Diego to connect about the issues that matter most.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=3988%2E5257348%2Ev8ikeP)
Hi Derek — In a moment, **[I’m going to ask you to chip in $10 with 10 days to go until our FEC fundraising deadline.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sep2023_abs_em.H56YJI&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20230920_AM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=4&akid=3988%2E5257348%2Ev8ikeP)** But first, I want to explain why this deadline, the one coming up on September 30, is so important.

Running a statewide campaign in the most populous state in our country is no small feat — and it takes significant resources to reach as many voters as possible.
For the past few months, because of this grassroots team, I’ve been able to traverse the Golden State, meeting with folks from Sacramento to San Diego to connect about the issues that matter most.
Quality education 🎒. Health care 💊. Childcare 👶. Affordable housing 🏠. The climate crisis 🌳. Student loan debt 💰. Democracy 🏛️. Reproductive freedom 🗽.
But truth be told, to keep up my travels across California, we need to raise more.
The summer months slowed down our fundraising efforts, and as we look at our budget for the final quarter of the year, we’re going to have to make some tough decisions about our spending if we don’t meet our goal by September 30.
We plan our campaign’s resources quarter-by-quarter, along the deadlines set by the Federal Election Commission — and that makes this next fundraising goal especially crucial.
To keep our campaign running full steam ahead, to stay on the road meeting with voters, to maximize the impact of our field programs, I need your help over these next 10 days:
**[Can you pitch in $10 to help us meet, and maybe even surpass, our quarterly fundraising goal?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sep2023_abs_em.H56YJI&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20230920_AM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=6&akid=3988%2E5257348%2Ev8ikeP)**

**OHIO FREEDOM ACTION NETWORK

(OhioFAN)

ABOUT NOVEMBER'S ISSUE 1!**

---
|
GFI is forwarding this message from the Executive Committee of the Ohio Freedom Action Network (OhioFAN) because it has a wealth of information on what you can do to help defeat November's Issue 1 ballot initiative. PLEASE READ & FORWARD TO EVERYONE YOU CAN! THANK YOU!

Greetings:

As you are no doubt aware, Issue 1 will be on the ballot on November 7th. Issue 1 is extreme and dangerous, and will erode parental rights and allow abortion to the day of birth. Many members of OhioFAN are interested in defeating Issue 1, and this email has helpful information to help you to get involved.

YARD SIGNS:

Protect Women Ohio, which is a consortium of many groups across Ohio, has purchased 150K yard signs for distribution throughout Ohio. Below is information on how you can access the yard signs and then help distribute them.

MORE TRAINING: i360 – Door Knocking Leader Training
* This training will cover the basics of the i360 app. You’ll learn how to use it for door knocking, how to make lists for anyone you recruit to do door knocking, etc.
* Please note: This training is for leaders, not individual volunteers. However, if you have one or more individuals you plan to have help out on an administrative level with your team, please feel free to invite them, as well.
* Sign up at: _[https://www.createdequal.org/i360/](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=5a5f1a5514&e=5c740fa3e2)_

PROTECT WOMEN OHIO ACTION: Paid and volunteer opportunities!
1. Paid canvassing- Earn $15-$20/ hour plus mileage, and people can set their own hours.

* * They visit homes of Pro-Life and persuadable Pro-Life voters with a simple survey that informs them why they should vote NO in November.
* Field Reps can work between 4-40 hours per week.

2. Volunteer* canvassing opportunities
3. Volunteer* phone calling

*If you prefer a volunteer position, Michelle will connect you with the team at Created Equal.

Contact: Michelle Ashley, State Director, Susan B Anthony Prolife America/Protect Women Ohio Action, 513.349.1955, [michelle@sbalistfield.org](mailto:michelle@sbalistfield.org)

TALKING POINTS: Here are some tips on engaging on Issue 1 with your friends, family and neighbors:
* * Promote the 'No' focus group talking points:
* Issue 1 is dangerous and extreme
* Issue 1 makes it legal in Ohio for a baby to be aborted up the Day of Birth for any eason
* Issue 1 takes away Parental Rights to make medical decisions for their children, including decisions about sex change surgeries
* Issue 1 removes important medical care protections for Ohio women by allowing non-certified individuals to perform important medical procedures on women

Thank you for taking the time to read through this, and please let me know if you have any questions.

IGWT,
Angie, Beth, Dan, Kirsten, Mary, Patty, Sandie and Tom
OhioFAN Executive Committee

subject: Number One story on Fox News
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
What they are up to is nuts.
#
Derek,
If you asked Fox News, the #1 story in the United States right now is how I dress. **You would think it's the biggest scandal in years, since they won't talk about anything else.**
Take a look at Fox News when we learned that child poverty *doubled* over the last year because of the end of the Expanded Child Tax Credit:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230920-1?refcode=em20230920-1&refcode2=8574_434096_HntXzP&akid=8574%2E434096%2EHntXzP)
Or how about Fox News when we're just days away from a potential government shutdown, impacting millions of Americans:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230920-1?refcode=em20230920-1&refcode2=8574_434096_HntXzP&akid=8574%2E434096%2EHntXzP)
Here's Fox News when the House GOP has failed to present any real evidence for their sham impeachment:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230920-1?refcode=em20230920-1&refcode2=8574_434096_HntXzP&akid=8574%2E434096%2EHntXzP)
And this is Fox News when a member of Congress got caught vaping + grabbing the hog at a live musical in Denver, a thing that really happened:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230920-1?refcode=em20230920-1&refcode2=8574_434096_HntXzP&akid=8574%2E434096%2EHntXzP)
While they're obsessing over how I dress, it's all a distraction from the real scandal at hand. **We have to stand up to the fringe right that's sowing chaos + threatening to drive the government off a cliff with a shutdown in just days.**
**[The working people of PA sent me to the Senate to solve big problems, no matter my outfit. That's what I'm focused on. Chip in today to help power that work.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230920-1?refcode=em20230920-1-8574&refcode2=8574_434096_HntXzP&akid=8574%2E434096%2EHntXzP)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230920-1?refcode=em20230920-8574&refcode2=8574_434096_HntXzP&akid=8574%2E434096%2EHntXzP)**
I'm glad you're on this team as we do the important work to make things better for working families in PA + everywhere. THANK YOU! 🙏
❤️ John
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator, Pennsylvania

Having spent a significant amount of time on this issue, I believe AI and automation can contribute to the economy in ways that don’t lead to significant unemployment. That's why we need three key solutions:
1. **Ethical AI** – We must ensure AI tools follow our laws _without exception. _
2. **Empower the American Dream** – it's not just about preventing a robot takeover, it's about equipping our workforce to harness AI.
3. **Fortify our National Security With AI** – Our adversaries are not waiting. We have to be proactive. By equipping our military and intelligence apparatus with cutting-edge AI tools, we can anticipate threats rather than merely react to them.

AI isn't on the horizon, it's here – and we have to shape it before it shapes us. **[Chip in today and help me prepare us for a productive future with AI and talk about the issues that really matter.](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=34d89e461aaa44c78b8907f4a4a14a11&_m=359a0aac75104f4da14cb64806bfd062&_e=S8Uy-fSRHffD82PQj93ojo9op4TO3qgK1V53s2H8cF3BAIlWGCg8lyNuEkaMtF4y0mf9L8S7fr2eMAsah3k4O-OChqTjSpm4cjWJkdQeQ0nV5aRDdyIFNw4-0VzRB-6lK4sfot0LfCD8ihxEchQqVoBaetYjqCp8yTdi_u4Mb2cm7Cn7NiQvSbNBBUhUOrWZ1vSqsvfGeZhGZuwXfzt8ID88XtrgujZ05YkSTGdQrLrNeVyyJr7iWYcKv_Bs5N-U1KXruyK5mEwWf0-07vlTfkJJVNosHu5Kgrq4ZqKWJbzVLwMHXpct5luI2UuTVH2ujfHIw2JWvac1Pq1AxL4k25-odnJcC3kw0vdp1ncPKUucJoAd-HfNbbp1d-VYK0d8)** Thank you,**Will Hurd** _Candidate for President & Former TX Congressman_ _[P.S. I'm praying God will touch your heart as you read this letter to help me save my son, Michael.

Michael is a police officer who dedicated his life to keeping our community safe in Farmers Branch, Texas.

_**But now he might be facing a life sentence in prison for shooting a dangerous career criminal who tried to run Michael down in a stolen truck.**_

[**Will you help my son?**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=db9d93f9d0f54f6cbd8812d287f5c39d&_e=-elV94i2BiN3hfHdMXdOdIx4XjGV9Msk0cHLHCOVXVX28JJ0O1ZnwfLgFyPyzENfWIARGMvaytMs6ccRssx8-d_YkLgujWZ2PBgzedqngr2a2EGaoqO7LtR8TbPI4xyUmZ0jD13iyRA_e9Tdbf0cP0QpmpKWCercEmdx4vQa3ANZ7K7znv1ZylL3fiILTCQzV0iXtoLjbEoT-4DgNg7lKRcjPb2HI0dqpGKVqCUnF_Fe_8eXTI409ygHiHR6RHA5K5BTOFQHzzA-LwStXx6iwn-toiLxJaWVKU_u36FqOL7o55NQvMaq7LTo3YPFon25IJGicrtLrzOnlfv1YumxoVKPvEO_Kh69XO6ya4b_Hje9ywT2I2wpa9lkv9DtBz8z)

That's Michael in the photo.

[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=db9d93f9d0f54f6cbd8812d287f5c39d&_e=-elV94i2BiN3hfHdMXdOdIx4XjGV9Msk0cHLHCOVXVX28JJ0O1ZnwfLgFyPyzENfWIARGMvaytMs6ccRssx8-d_YkLgujWZ2PBgzedqngr2a2EGaoqO7LtR8TbPI4xyUmZ0jD13iyRA_e9Tdbf0cP0QpmpKWCercEmdx4vQa3ANZ7K7znv1ZylL3fiILTCQzV0iXtoLjbEoT-4DgNg7lKSBst7_gUIw_Qq4hKwNHHl-B8M0Osv0Fnr5RjLromOYaPQIP3H6RMiJVwleKaT-aMxuYOs6nKAPlM2rWNj6X2pzcIjyeTa0p3k941X4QkSDW0fV4kB_-kky42v2xlxpR_YjqzzE_j9APREKk_ovFKIP16CPzPsiagluwDh4p5lw-) [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=db9d93f9d0f54f6cbd8812d287f5c39d&_e=-elV94i2BiN3hfHdMXdOdIx4XjGV9Msk0cHLHCOVXVX28JJ0O1ZnwfLgFyPyzENfWIARGMvaytMs6ccRssx8-d_YkLgujWZ2PBgzedqngr2a2EGaoqO7LtR8TbPI4xyUmZ0jD13iyRA_e9Tdbf0cP0QpmpKWCercEmdx4vQa3ANZ7K7znv1ZylL3fiILTCQzV0iXtoLjbEoT-4DgNg7lKTTV1cCvUEXOJvnmF32dlWsrnZruTH_hrW1X-JKNe4DXVqE-bGwiqlNC0FLazbTpZPCLFn_0T5noZbmCxl9Iyrkg5_6VmIbJE66FxVQY1EI1zLQaTf8VAD3GB_LzOyAntgV097MHeVHB_vLNJ6aFD9VmUrISRTxpJdtK9dR7bTlx)

In addition to being a police officer, Michael is also a Master Gunnery Sergeant in the United Stated Marine Corps Reserve.

I knew when he joined the police department that it was a dangerous job.

Every night on the news I saw another story of a police officer ambushed or killed in the line of duty.

It's been a heart wrenching time for the families of police officers in recent years.

What I didn't expect was that so many Americans would turn their backs on Michael in his time of need.

I now realize that it's all about fear. Fear of being attacked as a racist.

Fear of going against woke politicians and bureaucrats.

Fear of losing their jobs.

I assumed that the police department, the prosecutor's office, and everyone else in the government and the community would have Michael's back.

**But I was wrong.**

_So_ _now_ _Michael 's_ _life_ _is_ _at_ _stake_ _for_ _simply_ _doing_ _his_ _job_ _and_ _we_ _have_ _nobody_ _to_ _turn_ _to_ _except_ _for_ _good_ _hearted_ _strangers_ _like_ _you._

**[Will you please help me save my son Michael?](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=db9d93f9d0f54f6cbd8812d287f5c39d&_e=-elV94i2BiN3hfHdMXdOdIx4XjGV9Msk0cHLHCOVXVX28JJ0O1ZnwfLgFyPyzENfWIARGMvaytMs6ccRssx8-d_YkLgujWZ2PBgzedqngr2a2EGaoqO7LtR8TbPI4xyUmZ0jD13iyRA_e9Tdbf0cP0QpmpKWCercEmdx4vQa3ANZ7K7znv1ZylL3fiILTCQzV0iXtoLjbEoT-4DgNg7lKQDc4ko6p8pzzELd8U9eiUsgiYYUl1NNstSr6376N8l9zmI1IdBSecUrk4Wd0m7JRYbfF40OSzTzxAEWIA2QzwKjb7B2aw4lZzy4YZPvVytJS2wehGiIBwmyjANrEkZS-DPpRRMe5mOEeunFHvMm1N-QPWGmlrahNQQWSnTw0RSb)**

Let me give you some more of the details...

Michael and other Farmers Branch Police detectives tracked a stolen pickup truck to the parking lot of an "adult arcade."

The truck was stolen by a convicted felon who was well-known to the police.

Michael was assigned the task of arresting this man.

When the suspect came back to the truck, Michael pulled up and stepped out of his police car.

The criminal sped the stolen truck toward him.

Michael had to do what every police officer hopes they never have to do: he drew his weapon and fired.

The man driving the stolen truck died at the scene.

My son suffered back and leg injuries.

Michael had a split-second to think about if the career criminal speeding toward him was going to crush him to death with that stolen truck.

In that split-second, he did what he needed to do in order to save his own life and the lives of his fellow officers and community.

There's no doubt in my mind, and many others, that Michael made the right choice that day.

He should be considered a hero for putting his life on the line to protect others.

But now he might be facing a life sentence in prison for shooting a dangerous career criminal who tried to run Michael down in a stolen truck. That's Michael in the photo. In addition to being a police officer, Michael is also a Master Gunnery Sergeant in the United Stated Marine Corps Reserve. I knew when he joined the police department that it was a dangerous job. Every night on the news I saw another story of a police officer ambushed or killed in the line of duty. It's been a heart wrenching time for the families of police officers in recent years. What I didn't expect was that so many Americans would turn their backs on Michael in his time of need. I now realize that it's all about fear. Fear of being attacked as a racist. Fear of going against woke politicians and bureaucrats. Fear of losing their jobs. I assumed that the police department, the prosecutor's office, and everyone else in the government and the community would have Michael's back. But I was wrong. So now Michael 's life is at stake for simply doing his job and we have nobody to turn to except for good hearted strangers like you. Let me give you some more of the details... Michael and other Farmers Branch Police detectives tracked a stolen pickup truck to the parking lot of an "adult arcade." The truck was stolen by a convicted felon who was well-known to the police. Michael was assigned the task of arresting this man. When the suspect came back to the truck, Michael pulled up and stepped out of his police car. The criminal sped the stolen truck toward him. Michael had to do what every police officer hopes they never have to do: he drew his weapon and fired. The man driving the stolen truck died at the scene. My son suffered back and leg injuries. Michael had a split-second to think about if the career criminal speeding toward him was going to crush him to death with that stolen truck. In that split-second, he did what he needed to do in order to save his own life and the lives of his fellow officers and community. There's no doubt in my mind, and many others, that Michael made the right choice that day. He should be considered a hero for putting his life on the line to protect others. But right and wrong seem to have been turned upside down in the last few years. Why else would they be trying to put my son in prison for murder for what he did? That's why I'm willing to do whatever it takes to clear his name. After the incident, Michael was distraught to hear the criminal died. But the other officers assured him the shooting was justified. And then our whole world was rocked. Just 8 days after the incident Michael was indicted. Experts described the indictment as "unusually swift." The president of the Dallas Police Association said: "We have never had an investigation completed in less than eight days ready to hand over to the District Attorney. Never." I knew in my heart something was wrong - and we would be facing the fight of our lives to defend Michael in court. We started a fundraising campaign on the internet site "GoFundMe" to raise money for a proper legal defense. After a few days, "GoFundMe" shut down the fundraiser. They claimed Michael's actions as a police officer were an "act of hate" \- and helping him violated their terms of service. So in this anti-police climate, politically woke climate, the case was closed in their minds. No "innocent until proven guilty." No due process. Instead, my son was smeared as a "murderer" who committed a "hate crime." Since then, my husband and I spent half our life savings on legal fees and bills to help Michael. With the investigation devastating my family... seeing Michael, an American hero, being smeared on the internet... and our family quickly running out of money to pay mounting court fees... hope was fading. Until we heard about the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). LELDF is the best friend a police officer could ever have. LELDF defends good officers, like my son, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty. The group's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department. And praise the Lord, LELDF saw it fit to help my son! You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. It doesn't receive any funds from the government to help our police officers. Or, if the Lord has blessed you with the means to help with a I pray you will consider doing so. Please know any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing. If you can't help financially today, I understand. And please keep Michael and our family in your prayers. My son Michael is an American hero who served our nation and his community. He shouldn't be locked behind bars for defending his life from a career criminal. That 's a picture of Michael with his daughter - my granddaughter - Mary-Kaitlyn That 's a picture of Michael with his Son - my grandson - William I pray you never go through something like this. But if you do, may God touch the hearts of kind people to help you - just as I'm praying He'll touch your heart to help my son today. Sincerely, Margaret Mary Dunn PS: LELDF relies on caring people like you to send donations so they can fight tooth and nail to help wrongly-accused police officers like Michael. And because LELDF is a non-profit, all donations are tax-deductible. Your kind to help Michael will mean so much to my family. \---------------- More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit www.leldf.org. And remember - Blue Lives Matter! subject: Mississippi Fat Cat Report Published
body:

---
| |
---
| Dear Friend,

**The 2023 Mississippi Fat Cat report, just published by the Mississippi Center for Public Policy, reveals that our state has some of the highest paid public officials in America.** As well as having a State Superintendent for Public Education on $300,000 per year, Mississippi now has two local school superintendents each earning about a quarter of a million dollars a year.

---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=f105f05312&e=5703353baa)
---
Click on the image above to read more.
| **Mississippi’s fifty highest paid public officials now cost the taxpayer more than $10 million a year.** After an average 5 percent pay rise, the state’s highest paid officials saw their salaries rise from $193,678 on average last year to $205,000 this year.

This new report compares the salaries of the highest paid public officials in Mississippi to the average salaries of a nurses, state trooper or a teacher. We also compare Fat Cat pay to median Mississippi income.

**You might imagine that any list of the highest paid officials in our state would include the most senior elected officials. You would imagine wrong.** Mississippi’s Governor and Lieutenant Governor do not even make the list.

**Four in ten of the highest paid public officials in our state are in fact local school superintendents.** The school superintendents on the Fat Cat list received an average 14% pay increase, taking them to over $200,000 a year.

Mississippi’s Fat Cats do not just earn more than Mississippi’s governor. Mississippi’s highest paid public officials make on average more than America’s fifty state governors.

**Some local Mississippi superintendents, presiding over school districts with a few thousand students, are paid more than the****governor of Texas, whose state has a population of 30 million.**

To be clear, some highly paid public officials are worth every dollar. Some have highly specialise skills that could command an even larger salary in the private sector. **If only****Jackson, for example, had managed to pay proper salaries to properly qualified personnel, the city might have managed to avoid some of the water problems that have afflicted the city.**

Our report does not just shine a light on public sector pay, we suggest some reforms to give the legislature more oversight.

Read our report, and our policy recommendations, by clicking on the image above.

---

Douglas Carswell

body:
Hey friends, it’s John 👋 Got a second? I have a question for you: **** Hey friends, it’s John 👋 Got a second? I have a question for you:

_If you knew chipping in $5 to my friend Rep. Madeleine Dean *right now* could help us keep Pennsylvania blue and restore a Democratic majority in the House_ , _**[would you do it?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70045395/428154025/-850630802?amount=5&refcode=09202023_md_eoqprimer_fr_3&refcode2=00bc942f-d057-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMGJjOTQyZi1kMDU3LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ywByUqLO7LcBpzyEYse-yOOuiutnjr59pp3vQDKBMlQ=)**_ 💙

**Let me tell you about Mad Dean. She’s a badass defender of the people who sticks up for our rights in the face of attacks from MAGA extremists. She’s also just a great lady.**

I met Mad when we became unlikely allies in 2017. Despite our rivalry in the race for Lieutenant Governor, we connected on our statewide travels and a real friendship began to grow. One night Mad hosted an ice cream social in Harrisburg, and even though we were opponents, her brother Bob invited me to stop by, so I did. We stood side by side, scooping ice cream for happy — and slightly confused — voters. 🍦🍦🍦

Now in 2023, Mad and I are standing side by side on non-ice cream-related issues, and we still manage to have a little fun along the way. _**Like me, Mad is a proud Pennsylvanian who has spent her career advocating for her neighbors and their communities. I respect that.**_

| Fellow activist,

Yesterday was a BIG day in PA!

1\. On National Voter Registration Day, Governor Shapiro announced that Pennsylvania will now automatically register eligible Pennsylvanians to vote when they obtain or renew identification cards and driver licenses.

The following is a statement from New Pennsylvania Project CEO Kadida Kenner on Tuesday’s announcement from Gov. Josh Shapiro on the implementation of Automatic Voter Registration in Pennsylvania:

_“The announcement that Pennsylvania will begin utilizing PennDot as a means to automatically register more voters is welcomed news on National Voter Registration Day. The New Pennsylvania Project (NPP) is grateful that Governor Shapiro has taken these steps to increase Pennsylvanian’s access to the ballot box. With more than 1.2 million people eligible to vote but unregistered in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, today’s announcement will undoubtedly help to close the voter registration gap, especially in communities of color where the gap is the most pronounced. NPP looks forward to continuing our year round work of civic education, voter registration, mobilization, and advocating for additional necessary steps to improve Pennsylvanian’s access to democracy such as same-day voter registration and true early voting, and eliminating any unnecessary barriers to the ballot box.”_

2\. Special Election Alert: Voters in PA House District 21 elected **Lindsay Powell, who is now the first Black woman to represent the 21st District, keeping the Democratic majority in the state house.**
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/70045875/428155681/1465444750?refcode=EM_F_230921update_N_EN_90DO_9_G_N_LOGO&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM4OWYxZmUwLWQwNTctZWUxMS05OTM3LTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wS7o8LprzQf9PDcxFI8xkIciIaS2MuzxsNi8PXZxK-o=) There was a critical special election in Allegheny County for the PA State House District 21 after Democrat Sara Innamorato resigned from the Pennsylvania House of Representatives to focus her attention on the race for Allegheny County Executive.

This race was critical because, with Representative Innamorato’s resignation, the PA House was back at a 101-101 tie, which meant what happened during the special election was set to decide the majority of the State House - again.

These headlines are huge! Pennsylvanians deserve a reflective state legislature that prioritizes the needs of the community, and this major victory coupled with the announcement of automatic voter registration is just the beginning of the journey to achieve that.

body:
116,000 people have spoken and they must be heard. | | | Peter,
**We did it!** After a boiling hot summer hitting the streets and talking to every Atlantan we could find — at cookouts, farmers’ markets, dance parties, bars, restaurants, coffee shops, grocery stores, school pick-up lines, and even at their very doorsteps — **we delivered 116,000+ signatures to the City Clerk at Atlanta’s City Hall last Monday morning.** But our work doesn't stop there. Even though we have far exceeded the number of petitions required to make the ballot, the City Council still refuses to verify our signatures or drop an appeal of the lawsuit they brought against us to keep the Cop City measure off the ballot. However, this week, the Council made one small step forward by voting to digitize the petitions — the first move towards verification.
**[Will you donate now to help us keep the pressure up on the Atlanta City Council until they put our referendum on the ballot?](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953xntrmU4Lb-4yP0VLdtz0bTWh3n5KQb2Drhdz9DQoxbVJ_FQhihA2ZS8XxjQdMurcyi0AONMZRn9QjwwaIsmTAHg8J50ZPbjUC0HElgE5QjiZhSarwN9nz7d1Jb9z22VAji1aFpbQg6QoeWQA4XXsGl4S3clPebc9gT8L3YtTQhWHmVklsPU9MVdParp8AQxiqIE2hSndf6fSi7_b9EkC4VTeYFpYtXVbvTbCQrVhV9dJeu9IytNBGCvodCZaa6D5AlX6yhikUJL3ejzwYRG25_tDrT3G6dkC4d8LEuAr63i1wAgtoObUROUmqxHhK73Alq4Pb0FfkwgKmrx25By8SrZa_J8Ch70q_c0RqjZgQ-Pg/3zr/xIdGpcHuSVC0E4TQMM33gA/h0/e4PPnk8T_lMEy4-UBFYvWencsUWmLkDYA_lqMGsKIIs)** _[](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953xntrmU4Lb-4yP0VLdtz0bTWh3n5KQb2Drhdz9DQoxbVJ_FQhihA2ZS8XxjQdMurcyi0AONMZRn9QjwwaIsmTAHHj_3vmNcqNAfG6PV2jG8jGl2HHGb4X9Uzz7Q7Pg9jcm-HO0MHQEx-QDDoaBe5FdZUVTsb_E0k_FFqcJWTXNy6VSYapMzhUSsvDADIHSrB8jZn-UsscBLuScXlkuHQyTXsJ8fZlWOpxMIH06yRrcG7Js4UlA4fEsXfYSNXOgHHV4oElH9Uyo0zFWrdgRWlU75MWmc9-wTHpOgKneenkoMwHMEL-xlpsSPbWjTkohxQO7QN5gWu2Lxm7b-fKSe4soIUFkg7-AmjFh8nRWKmPoo5g/3zr/xIdGpcHuSVC0E4TQMM33gA/h1/kaXr7lRileLl5s0qtKoMuakKSiHfaG3DjOE3YMwIGcw)Yes, that’s me in the red pants, looking very happy indeed._ **[Donate to get Cop City on the ballot****](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953xntrmU4Lb-4yP0VLdtz0bTWh3n5KQb2Drhdz9DQoxbVJ_FQhihA2ZS8XxjQdMurcyi0AONMZRn9QjwwaIsmTAHIe6p4aKL8D2sSyvbEDnNF4fi0X77QC0UiChV70U4ApjBqscL7aIBWE6T9M7f9YFNyHcQDwClMTvydvP6ELD75INJqMfbyuhiPnOstN9UKOZ1rc94FCxHqV1IYL3Yb8pgLrL-RRji_hUquVP9X7rEzAb3BArZn630I3fJ_5m-F-J7NQ1yFMkjrDHoj37Lm0bnHgYNKZiGrmmJoFMUVl28Erzv8Fu7LaV8xy35xEjbeus3C44gm8NwIyAKCy3QCbdfo_BxUvRHSgKhHhp9Z5Mj_w/3zr/xIdGpcHuSVC0E4TQMM33gA/h2/5v9YdIWWmKct8ula5SkzNPza7jXGTG4p-yH5I9wYNWA)** Hi, my name is Aimee Castenell, and I’m a long-time resident of Atlanta and a proud member of the Cop City Vote Coalition. This summer, we formed a coalition made up of folks from all over Atlanta as well as organizations — including Working Families Power, the Movement for Black Lives, SONG Power, CASA in Action, GLAHR, and the Black Male Initiative Georgia (to name a few) — to launch a campaign to put a question on the ballot about Cop City to let Atlantans decide how they want to spend public money. Cop City is a proposed $90 million mock city for police training. If built, Cop City would include weapons and explosion testing, helicopter landings, and controlled building burns, making it an issue of profound importance to everyone, not only in the city of Atlanta but as we’ve seen by the support we’ve gotten from all over — a matter of importance to all of us. **A referendum isn’t just an ordinary vote; it’s a chance for Atlantans to directly shape the future of our city.** It’s an opportunity for residents to decide how millions of taxpayer dollars will be spent and how our city invests in public safety. It’s the embodiment of direct democracy on legislative decisions that impact us all. The referendum includes two crucial aspects: First, whether the City of Atlanta should lease 80+ acres of publicly-owned land in unincorporated Dekalb County to the Atlanta Police Foundation. Second, whether the City should allocate over $60 million to fund the construction of a new police training facility. **** **[All eyes are on Atlanta. Donate to help us _help them_ make the right decision today.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953xntrmU4Lb-4yP0VLdtz0bTWh3n5KQb2Drhdz9DQoxbVJ_FQhihA2ZS8XxjQdMurcyi0AONMZRn9QjwwaIsmTAHQJn9ubJRdAiqmRza5OYyvYF0s-Pl3MazAJIylLnZfRI6wf3geAmPm_FxX_VMtghCyiRnQOvy-1G2ziQ7GgBfIQtO6b5tlUgrjPDnQqx8I2Ek4mFWDHX_aMYpG9I-TOyxIOXbdOCT5wPSXjR7nTwFL1pZZfMTlp3Q1H4bzMzT1yzuv5OnBMtKTbwjgjsHDgiWjmC8OGV_EUQZHzmyGXOhYdEb7XU-AtsV7sNTtvtdtaSK1PmE7lkpI5qcJ_yGtciTrnrs1HwV04AXeJ7zbCrMgg/3zr/xIdGpcHuSVC0E4TQMM33gA/h3/DhFC8Zw8RF1g9EyEkmW3DbrxJx4OwT9ZNd6lEUrbslo)** [Donate to let the people decide. ](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953xntrmU4Lb-4yP0VLdtz0bTWh3n5KQb2Drhdz9DQoxbVJ_FQhihA2ZS8XxjQdMurcyi0AONMZRn9QjwwaIsmTAHG39d7jOGdg_34japOoHV3avi_d_zFDusgw3q0Uxv6e4t_-g6l57EbGvP0GgOf0UkrLww8anGc5VNf81YRfXgC3uGVxCzFlhqSqttwCWaC5DAHla3R4Vj4VYo9T6Ao_ZB2_aGFRK0tW98VYbPAk4f7pWFI_ceNAU4A5ltD_hvsKzBkZXWbKvwtCVvWqzUsRbBAsPq40MT6rfOu3LKf5mlYxpEaplTxOTtwA3qm7Z0LxqobCu0HYxZvAwO6vw9X0GWzNWlYz4f-I9r_THASRrBWw/3zr/xIdGpcHuSVC0E4TQMM33gA/h4/lC5bpC3h8ssXQ9SJik93bTTG9h-x8pvj2wzHdDJ_kLE) **Our strength is and has always been in our people. This summer, we had an army of over 500 volunteers who collected signatures in every corner of the City of Atlanta. Those who couldn’t canvass, called voters. Volunteers worked through the night to scan and document each petition. People like you from around the country donated to fuel this work.** And now, we have to come together again to demand the City of Atlanta stop wasting our time and respect the will of the people. **In the cradle of the Civil Rights movement, with a city run by Democrats, it’s especially shocking to see a democratic process be subverted in such a dishonest way.** The reality is that over 116,000 Atlantans have signed the petition to put Cop City on the ballot as a referendum. Each signature represents a voice calling for direct democracy and the right to make their voices heard at the ballot box. This groundswell of support cannot be ignored. We must hold our leaders accountable and ensure they respect our democratic principles. **[It's time to let the people decide.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953xntrmU4Lb-4yP0VLdtz0bTWh3n5KQb2Drhdz9DQoxbVJ_FQhihA2ZS8XxjQdMurcyi0AONMZRn9QjwwaIsmTAH02va61Qub8v9exfgX4W6BukrEmSUHmbrSiYjKXLVKZmfdf__yDjj9WZ2voxjGKaZlICMpVOdD5WZtZmESRR8p9D9eUq2-iww00t4v9NBuu-ELdTh9cSW-gUeU5rji7WwO6KpQCu8uO8tHqB5D1MMuGspYNCqFD8z1vY_uPdXo4aQG7PvDkTPOMGtAalxVBs7x-YoJV1KaDYQYcxwRaIltqpcPgEu8wVsFXWjAxNE5TQQo-5A4BCgenAZ5GfJv3MAFeAGhSoJQGzkCIMDcCzOYg/3zr/xIdGpcHuSVC0E4TQMM33gA/h5/XO14gjghqf4wSaC2LenJxkSuHnrZeLM6SIucFDQuquI)** In solidarity,

clean_body: 116,000 people have spoken and they must be heard. | | | Peter, We did it! After a boiling hot summer hitting the streets and talking to every Atlantan we could find — at cookouts, farmers’ markets, dance parties, bars, restaurants, coffee shops, grocery stores, school pick-up lines, and even at their very doorsteps — we delivered 116,000+ signatures to the City Clerk at Atlanta’s City Hall last Monday morning. But our work doesn't stop there. Even though we have far exceeded the number of petitions required to make the ballot, the City Council still refuses to verify our signatures or drop an appeal of the lawsuit they brought against us to keep the Cop City measure off the ballot. However, this week, the Council made one small step forward by voting to digitize the petitions — the first move towards verification. , that’s me in the red pants, looking very happy indeed. Hi, my name is Aimee Castenell, and I’m a long-time resident of Atlanta and a proud member of the Cop City Vote Coalition. This summer, we formed a coalition made up of folks from all over Atlanta as well as organizations — including Working Families Power, the Movement for Black Lives, SONG Power, CASA in Action, GLAHR, and the Black Male Initiative Georgia (to name a few) — to launch a campaign to put a question on the ballot about Cop City to let Atlantans decide how they want to spend public money. Cop City is a proposed $90 million mock city for police training. If built, Cop City would include weapons and explosion testing, helicopter landings, and controlled building burns, making it an issue of profound importance to everyone, not only in the city of Atlanta but as we’ve seen by the support we’ve gotten from all over — a matter of importance to all of us. A referendum isn’t just an ordinary vote; it’s a chance for Atlantans to directly shape the future of our city. It’s an opportunity for residents to decide how millions of taxpayer dollars will be spent and how our city invests in public safety. It’s the embodiment of direct democracy on legislative decisions that impact us all. The referendum includes two crucial aspects: First, whether the City of Atlanta should lease 80+ acres of publicly-owned land in unincorporated Dekalb County to the Atlanta Police Foundation. Second, whether the City should allocate over $60 million to fund the construction of a new police training facility. ** Our strength is and has always been in our people. This summer, we had an army of over 500 volunteers who collected signatures in every corner of the City of Atlanta. Those who couldn’t canvass, called voters. Volunteers worked through the night to scan and document each petition. People like you from around the country donated to fuel this work. And now, we have to come together again to demand the City of Atlanta stop wasting our time and respect the will of the people. In the cradle of the Civil Rights movement, with a city run by Democrats, it’s especially shocking to see a democratic process be subverted in such a dishonest way. The reality is that over 116,000 Atlantans have signed the petition to put Cop City on the ballot as a referendum. Each signature represents a voice calling for direct democracy and the right to make their voices heard at the ballot box. This groundswell of support cannot be ignored. We must hold our leaders accountable and ensure they respect our democratic principles. In solidarity, Aimee Castenell Working Families Power Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Of all the things Americans want their government to do, impeachment is about last on the list. Very few American adults believe the impeachment inquiry is a serious effort. They are right, and Scott Perry’s Chaos Caucus is wrong.

[Help me keep the focus on America’s real priorities. Support our campaign to defeat Scott Perry by making a grassroots donation of any amount.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70050168/428170210/2145924871?amount=10&source=RC_EM_FR_WL_230920_1_1&refcode2=3d7dfc8e-d857-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&contactdata=tr7rRR3ZNWR52WdpLaOl0nyiF1U7NT4rU71vuGPd8zINIOc+JYiwnqF9hBC8sZOv&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZDdkZmM4ZS1kODU3LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=N5FArKlvo45hUT6XOknegyuao6_Q2IvCRBZsXm_pZgA=)

We want to _defend our democracy_ that so many have given their lives to preserve. Jan. 6 traitor Scott Perry tried to throw away millions of PA votes for no valid reason. Thankfully, he failed. As usual.

Where we live in central PA, we overwhelmingly want to _protect reproductive freedom for women_. Scott Perry wants to take that freedom away.

We want to _stop the epidemic of gun violence_ by enacting common-sense gun safety measures like background checks. Scott Perry refuses to recognize the problem that plagues our communities and is killing our children.

We believe the government can help _ensure family financial security_ by enacting a living wage and saving Social Security and Medicare. Scott Perry wants people to work for peanuts and is trying hard to destroy Social Security and Medicare.

We want to _solve the childcare crisis_ that impoverishes working parents and prevents some parents from working at all. Scott Perry supports taking childcare away from 3 million children now covered by our nation’s response to COVID-19.

**Don’t let Scott Perry and the Chaos Caucus change the subject.**

The phony impeachment plan is a distraction. In essence, Scott Perry is telling you that you are foolish to be concerned about the things that really matter to you. In fact, we would be foolish to follow his lead.

[Scott Perry does not represent us. He must go. And I’m the guy to send him packing. _**Revolutionizing rural healthcare: The untapped power of virtual care**_ By Bobby Jindal & Justin Schreiber
---
For more than 46 million people who live in rural areas, a growing healthcare crisis is looming as more than 600 rural hospitals across the United States stand at risk of closing. While ensuring healthcare access for these remote but critical communities has long been a challenge, the growing prevalence of telehealth in recent years has extended a necessary lifeline as access to “brick-and-mortar” care declines.

As a nation, we have reached a critical decision point on whether we make it easier or harder for these communities to access the care they need. In Washington , a bipartisan group of lawmakers has introduced a promising proposal in the Telehealth Expansion Act of 2023. Designed to ensure access to telehealth services for those with high-deductible health plans and health savings accounts, the bill would allow employers and health plans to cover telehealth visits without requiring people to meet their deductibles. We have seen this flexible policy in action, and that it can be successful, thanks to provisions put in place by the CARES Act. Its expansion of telehealth has helped families maintain access to affordable, virtual care services on a pre-deductible basis throughout the pandemic. This has enabled health education and interventions typically provided in person to start at the moment they are needed, without compromising care due to fear of high costs, deductibles, or matters of convenience. **[FINISH READING ON WASHINGTONEXAMINER.COM](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=fa1e8a28fc60471a9a22ffbffb5662dc&_e=3hD7hzylqkFwGuBCQoQIPbgT9ZwPttihvFnktGO6kf4UqSeUj627sT8hNDbJ0L-H-rIt6aByZNGV5NHHP6c_aX0I5-29Rahu0vkoEZ7AjqyXUodtVktXKftESipBFd1wUV_K3FLxF64WZDqNwBXjxl88vmg63IXLYbabyVk2QnsLgbk4OeSBhWhd3LlExc0BaCYAPDrldPslFMEHxJPgKAXkP31xi50hKP8a_qSI3S-rK3aNy2DokgkqLSAL6qWQyqEB7xcdaFPrVS6vLZedIt7ouF8XSFnkLTST8DoF2epLts1Q5mLfRVejrRld1Tad2QI7HAWDbcRuOUI5oZo-Y-zMD4uXoniQo490iqbqDzE%3D)**

[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/681216bc-deed-4d02-91af-4ce30e848fd4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And here at the 1776 Project PAC, we are doing everything we can to ensure that our endorsed candidates win their races, follow through on their promises, and protect your kids.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/36b7e9d2-79d8-442d-bf86-c7da4a61445f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In states like Pennsylvania, Kansas, Virginia, and Ohio, we've unveiled a slate of top-tier candidates who will deliver big results as we restore sanity to our schools, one school board at a time.
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/681216bc-deed-4d02-91af-4ce30e848fd4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**BIG WIN IN THE BUCKEYE STATE**
And yet another major victory in the state of Ohio, as Mentor Public Schools this month passed a policy addressing sexual content in the classroom.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/46a14889-92dd-4900-8d0b-6f33c7897a50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Policy 2520.03 lays out a clear process for review of questionable, sexually-charged materials.
The policy includes:
-Parental notification
-Access to review the materials
-Option to request alternate material that does not include sexual content.
**We put the pressure on and won.**
And we've also endorsed two candidates, Gil Martello and Roes Ioppolo, in the upcoming Mentor Exempted Village school board race this November. These candidates are committed to working harder than ever to save out schools - and they need your support.
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/681216bc-deed-4d02-91af-4ce30e848fd4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
At of the center of our mission - and the mission of every candidate we endorse- is ensuring that children are protected and parents are notified anytime school curriculum includes sexually-based materials.
**BUT THERE 'S STILL SO MUCH WORK TO BE DONE **
For example, the Perkiomen Valley School Board in Montgomery County, Pennsylvania, rejected a policy to stop boys from using the girls' bathroom.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e441b546-abb8-4f92-8d38-e3720573bb3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We have made five key endorsements in this district. So on November 7th, families in Perkiomen Valley can vote to protect their daughters and restore sanity to our schools.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0d7dd3df-1854-4e2f-9418-a3191d0d2abf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And out in Michigan, [emails show](https://substack.com/redirect/590d8c1a-9e4b-462b-9ae3-374abf4d85d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that two teachers in the Brandywine school district intentionally undermined the school board by applying for a grant to sneak politically-charged, far-left materials into the classroom.
The stunt came just weeks after the school board passed a policy to prohibit such behavior and is just another example of why transparency and accountability in the classroom is more important than ever.
This is a district we flipped last election cycle. But far-left activist teachers are trying to undermine all the success. The good news is: It's not going to work.
**VOTE TO SAVE OUR SCHOOLS**
Here at the 1776 Project PAC we are a true grassroots movement. We've officially raised over $1 million this year **with an average donation of $26.31** from nearly 40,000 donors across the country.
And in state after state, candidates we've helped get elected are making an immediate change. From ending Critical Race Theory, to establishing parental bills of rights, and to destroying the pronoun mafia, we've seen one success story after another.
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/8fbe5cf4-464f-419e-b1ae-8fe9fc1a20c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
That's what you call getting things done. That's putting your dollars into action - and making sure that every dollar you donate goes to the cause of stopping left-wing indoctrination in school.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/49242d9e-99af-4087-9857-8ebfd7530189?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And as we've told you, we're committed to endorsing the top school board candidates around the country, recently rolling out endorsements in states like Pennsylvania, Ohio, Kansas, and Virginia.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/407ffb9b-3bb1-408b-a026-49642b2d54eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
These are candidates who believe that patriotism is at the core of education.
They believe that indoctrination has no place in the classroom.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/efb1c6fa-c624-441a-b782-6ca757587874?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
They will stop Critical Race Theory in its tracks.
They will end gender ideology madness in the classroom.
And most of all, they will make life better for hard-working students and their families.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cb2565ac-2443-4bb2-99e0-c142608096a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/8fbe5cf4-464f-419e-b1ae-8fe9fc1a20c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We're winning this fight. We're ousting far-left activists from one school board after another.
And with your help, there's only going to be more huge victories.
The stakes could not be higher. And we're just getting started.

Unveiling Its Terrifying Realities!**

The silent erosion of the dollar's purchasing power has left hardworking Americans like you vulnerable, as your savings and investments are silently devaluing.

It's time to expose the deception and **[take decisive steps toward securing your financial future.](http://email.email.a1warroom.com/c/eJw8jr1uxCAQhJ8GOluw3MFRUORHThEpfcqNAZtoCRx2YvntI1tR2plP8w3mSinujplHBjAnvzAAph4YwP19y-37M7--dBS27q7f8vUo4YkBrHsN_-TfSB8yJjpS88y9Q40xeB6c1PYKSoLVfHZCmPFDqmiEBX2VEI00JlobY9QGQfDkQIASFoQ0SindozXRoxW3GK0X-sYu4hT1KDdsrZTcjyVzcvO61uV8NDAYqPZIFKaEX2OYCvmDYjD4NKUVqfOFCFu3rAFp6WpLPzjuDAbenK9bIkqLNuwiptM1lvwbAAD__zmvW4g)**

**The signs of the dollar's decline are impossible to ignore**. Inflation is soaring and the cost of everyday goods and services are spiraling out of control.

The government's assurances that this is merely a temporary phenomenon is an utter lie as the hardworking middle class struggles to make ends meet. The erosion of your purchasing power is no accident; it is a consequence of policies that prioritize short-term gains over your long-term financial security. **It doesn’t stop there.** Amidst all the lies and chaos, President Biden snuck in Executive Order 14067. name: Maj. Gen. Paul Eaton, USA, Ret.
subject: You’re wrong, Senator Tuberville
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS ACTION FUND
body:
I was at the Capitol yesterday with Senators Jack Reed, Tammy Duckworth, Elizabeth Warren, Tim Kaine, Amy Klobuchar, and Chris Murphy.
#
Derek, Paul Eaton here.
I was at the Capitol yesterday with Senators Jack Reed, Tammy Duckworth, Elizabeth Warren, Tim Kaine, Amy Klobuchar, and Chris Murphy.
We put up signs for each of the 300+ officers who have had their promotions frozen and blockaded by Senator Tuberville.
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/3042?c0=vv-c4-em-traitors-live.EyPH7c&refcode=em230920-1-15&t=1&akid=17245%2E3013755%2E0yeFiB)
We wanted to do something Tuberville couldn’t ignore. And in a story by Military.com, we learned that we accomplished our objective:
_“‘I just saw it when I was driving over, saw it from the window,’ said Tuberville, who added he was impressed by the display before he was told it was about him. ‘I've got more support than they probably got.’”_
He’s dead wrong. Veterans are behind these officers. The American people are behind them. And polls done by reputable organizations in the state of Alabama show that even the people of his own state are behind these officers — against Tuberville. Even Republicans.
Several of his own colleagues publicly oppose him — Dan Crenshaw in the House and Lisa Murkowski in the Senate, to name just two. Unfortunately, the vast majority of Republicans are silent and complicit, but we’re starting to see some cracks in the wall.
Tuberville will not win. This ends when we confirm them all, and let our fighting men and women do what they do best.
So please: Help us keep the pressure on.

They're _**shutting down**_ pipelines. They're _**terminating**_ leasing contracts. They're making it _**harder for our country to produce our own energy**_ right here in the United States.

body:
Why do we ask for the equivalent of a cup of fancy coffee?
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=687%2E135344%2EsgIZpz)

Hey there -- we're asking you to make a $5 donation today to support Elissa Slotkin’s campaign for Senate in Michigan.
Sometimes people ask us why we ask for the equivalent of a cup of fancy coffee. They question whether small donations actually matter. They do. It takes a village to get this done, and it’s so important that we maintain a steady pace of support.
Earlier this month, we had our first serious Republican opponent enter the race. Mike Rogers, or whomever the Republican nominee is, will no doubt see a flood of support from deep-pocketed Republican donors like Betsy DeVos, corporate PACs, and Super PACs who will all spend millions of dollars on their behalf in order to flip Michigan red. Because they know that their path to control the Senate runs right through Michigan.
**With public polling showing our race in a dead heat, we have to be prepared to match our Republican opponent dollar-for-dollar so we can defend this open seat and protect our slim Democratic Senate majority.**
We know that $5 may not sound like a lot on its own, but trust us, we wouldn’t keep asking if it didn’t add up when there are hundreds of people chipping in and showing their support. It’s how we’ve won our past campaigns and it’s how we plan to keep up the momentum to win this race too.
[**If you are able, will you make a $5 contribution to our campaign for Senate today? It’s not as much about how much you give, but how many people are coming together to show their support for Elissa and this campaign.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep23.hbnlDo&refcode=em230920-1-60&t=2&akid=687%2E135344%2EsgIZpz)**

clean_body: This Marine and mayor is exactly the leader we need in Congress. | | Fellow conservative, Congressional Democrats won’t know what hit them... Kevin Lincoln just announced his candidacy for California’s 9th Congressional District – one of the top seats we’re targeting to flip in 2024. This is a game changer in this toss-up race, He’s a Marine Corps veteran who was selected to serve on the Marine One aircraft protecting the president in the aftermath of 9/11. He defeated a powerful Democratic incumbent to become mayor of one of California’s largest cities and has led it out of the economic hardship caused by COVID restrictions while reducing crime and homelessness. A Marine Corps veteran... who gets results. He's exactly the kind of leader we need in Congress! Kevin has my full support, but he really needs yours... Sincerely, Steve Scalise House Republican Leader | Meet Kevin Lincoln My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran. Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader. I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton. Like , Follow , and Subscribe! Friend,
AI is going to have a powerful and lasting impact on our economy. Automation is already a significant driver of inequality in America, and when coupled with the stresses and instability for displaced workers it’s clear we have to do something about it and fast.
The question is what to do and what is the government role. I’ve lived this, I’ve studied this, I’ve talked to hundreds of folks about it. And if I’m elected I will be part of the conversation.
Nearly two dozen leaders of tech companies and other groups met last Wednesday behind closed doors with U.S. senators as part of a broader discussion into how Congress can regulate artificial intelligence. Having a bunch of homogenized career politicians make these decisions behind closed doors is not the answer.
We deserve better.
I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need representation that understands the needs and hardships faced by the people they represent.

**Americans for Prosperity Action Endorses Ryan Mackenzie for Congress

_The key early endorsement further solidifies Mackenzie's position as the Republican leader in Pennsylvania 7th Congressional District._**

**(LOWER MACUNGIE, Pa.)** \- Ryan Mackenzie, Republican candidate running for the U.S. House of Representatives in Pennsylvania's 7th Congressional District, is proud to receive the endorsement of Americans for Prosperity Action (AFP Action).

In a recent [POLITICO](http://links.mackenzieforcongress.com/u/click?_t=e09c1376a1134fb5bbc6c87f9d1914fb&_m=bb96e3d45ca54cbca8df67d3d2cb68dd&_e=ry5bw-DEiWdY7buua3j6OzZJessKysx3gVjWe-vgRe2W0p-mYpf-tkAbbyTCaxtjjPPIvr5rZwqfXBQvwjfo_Hqoua95hyVSi4IkiwcQlqnDHdmZb5aPTRR6rThzzf7HeI8_eo9vgk4l9XpCNjB9gSH8J1JU5v-LpNVtZ_ksHIjuoi8FR4TIZyXQ1yLpCtyEl3bNtZ1-FVLPVtoRJfAMgEI9pB979zRJ4gyVtkkxpB6sbTojqKxn8z_tapGrqmDcpnp9ecYT4pXRgwpc7NZhF1FoFoxoQB9IZy-W9PjyJq4%3D) report highlighting the endorsement, AFP Action Director Nathan Nascimento said "AFP Action is mobilizing our grassroots network from coast to coast to help the strongest candidates win their 2024 primaries - and go on to win in the general election."

Americans for Prosperity is a highly influential national organization dedicated to promoting economic freedom and individual liberties.

Following the endorsement, Ryan Mackenzie stated the following:

_"I am honored to receive support of AFP Action in this critical race. It is important that we elect proven conservative leaders committed to ensuring freedom and opportunity to represent us in the U.S. House of Representatives. As a Member of Congress, I will stand up for Pennsylvania's hard-working families by turning around the American economy, improving access to affordable healthcare, and expanding educational options for students."_

Ryan Mackenzie was also recently endorsed by Carla Sands, former U.S. Ambassador to Denmark under President Donald J. Trump for his proven record of supporting America first policies.

* * *
_When it comes to fighting for American freedoms and helping others, Ryan Mackenzie has had some great teachers.

A 9th generation resident of the Lehigh Valley, Ryan's first ancestor to settle in our area fought in the Northampton County Militia during the Revolutionary War. In more recent generations, his family members helped build companies like Hercules Cement, served our country in both World Wars, and served our community here at home in professions like nursing and teaching.

It's that spirit of service that inspired Ryan to fight back against the Far Left here in Pennsylvania. Ryan faced an all-out assault by the abortion industry in his first race, and he beat them back. Rush Limbaugh said of Ryan: "Planned Parenthood took it on the chin ... Mackenzie won by an 18-point margin."

In Pennsylvania's state capitol, Ryan is known by conservatives and feared by the establishment as one of the most effective and proven reformers in government. Ryan didn't just talk – he got our values enacted into law._

While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 – and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. = And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

name: Gene Karpinski, LCV
subject: [3X MATCH] Time is running out, Peter. Our planet's future is on the line.
body:
Time sensitive

Peter - our Membership Drive deadline is a few days away, and we're reaching out because we haven't heard from you yet (renew your membership here and your contribution will be tripled https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/w_ ).

The truth is your membership matters, and it's particularly critical right now.

Here's the situation: Earlier this month, Senator Joe Manchin backed away from a climate deal after months of negotiations, choosing to side with Big Oil and Republicans. It leaves the deal one vote short -- stalling any real action in Congress for now.

In response, we're redoubling our efforts on pushing the White House to act decisively on climate. The Biden administration has massive amounts of power to curb climate pollution - but that will only happen if the environmental movement makes it happen.

Right now, we're facing a critical test: the Biden administration is weighing a plan to block all new oil and gas drilling leases on public waters.

This could be huge -- and a decision is coming. Right now, we're organizing volunteers from all over the country to flood the administration with letters, pressuring Biden to hold to his promises.

Peter -- it's your membership support that makes victory possible here. But we have to do more. A group of donors has put together a fund to triple match every contribution before Sunday's membership deadline:

Can we count on your support? Claim your membership now - it only takes $5 >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/6Lg6B~

The ban on new oil and gas leases is the first of many huge environmental decisions, Peter. And right now, we're pushing for serious action on so many fronts -- including:
Setting tight standards for power plants and other major emitters of climate pollution
Placing strict limits on air pollution to safeguard all communities Expediting requirements of 100% tailpipe pollution-free new cars by 2035 and trucks by 2040
Protecting communities from hazardous and super-polluting methane Conserving 30% of our public lands and waters by 2030 Declaring a climate emergency - and so much more. The best way you can help win each and every one of these fights right now is to claim your LCV membership - all it takes is a gift of $5 or more. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/z9e0fb_

Thank you, thank you, thank you, Peter. This is such a critical moment for the environment, and we're so fortunate to have you on the team.

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters
