body:
[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1001&akid=1195%2E35263%2ETdaZ04 ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE

Hey Peter!

I wanted to give you a personal update on what I’ve been up to these past
few weeks. (I even have some photos to share with you from my travels!)

We had a packed room in Elkhorn, Wisconsin! There’s still over a year
before Election Day, but that isn’t stopping Walworth County Democrats
from hosting more than 150(!) grassroots supporters in the area. We talked
about the critical work needed on the ground to win this election,
especially in red-leaning districts, and how my work in the Senate has
benefited Wisconsin’s rural communities.

I always say: You can’t write off anybody. Don’t write off any area. You
have to show up to listen, but also follow up and be a champion for the
pocketbook-issues that everybody struggles with. That’s what I have done
in the Senate, and it’s what I’ll continue to do for every Wisconsinite.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-sep23.1u6uGA&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20230920_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=1195%2E35263%2ETdaZ04 ]Elkhorn

Recently, I joined the Rusk County Democrats to walk the County Fair in
Ladysmith. I thanked them for their hard work reaching rural voters in the
area and how significant that will be in this upcoming election.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-sep23.1u6uGA&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20230920_PM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=1195%2E35263%2ETdaZ04 ]Ladysmith

I was honored to receive the endorsement of the Wisconsin Laborers’
District Council and got to tour their training center. Unions are the
backbone of Wisconsin’s economy, and I will continue to have their backs
in the Senate. I’m so grateful they’ve got mine, too!

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-sep23.1u6uGA&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20230920_PM1_V1_S1&t=1006&akid=1195%2E35263%2ETdaZ04 ]Wisconsin Laborers’ District Council

And finally, I got to meet with medical students in Wauwatosa to discuss
reproductive freedom and my work to restore and expand protections for
Wisconsin women. We talked about the implications of the Dobbs decision in
states with restrictive abortion laws like ours, and the students got to
share their stories about how it has affected them.

I’m going to keep doing everything I can in the Senate to defend abortion
rights in our state and nationwide.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-sep23.1u6uGA&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20230920_PM1_V1_S1&t=1007&akid=1195%2E35263%2ETdaZ04 ]Wauwatosa

There’s nothing I enjoy more than traveling the state and meeting with the
folks I was elected to represent. It’s the most important part of the job,
and it’s all made possible thanks to members of this grassroots team —
that’s YOU!

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-sep23.1u6uGA&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20230920_PM1_V1_S1&t=1008&akid=1195%2E35263%2ETdaZ04 ]Can you help us keep this work going strong by pitching in to my

clean_body: [ ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE Hey Peter! I wanted to give you a personal update on what I’ve been up to these past few weeks. (I even have some photos to share with you from my travels!) We had a packed room in Elkhorn, Wisconsin! There’s still over a year before Election Day, but that isn’t stopping Walworth County Democrats from hosting more than 150(!) grassroots supporters in the area. We talked about the critical work needed on the ground to win this election, especially in red-leaning districts, and how my work in the Senate has benefited Wisconsin’s rural communities. I always say: You can’t write off anybody. Don’t write off any area. You have to show up to listen, but also follow up and be a champion for the pocketbook-issues that everybody struggles with. That’s what I have done in the Senate, and it’s what I’ll continue to do for every Wisconsinite. [ ]Elkhorn Recently, I joined the Rusk County Democrats to walk the County Fair in Ladysmith. I thanked them for their hard work reaching rural voters in the area and how significant that will be in this upcoming election. [ ]Ladysmith I was honored to receive the endorsement of the Wisconsin Laborers’ District Council and got to tour their training center. Unions are the backbone of Wisconsin’s economy, and I will continue to have their backs in the Senate. I’m so grateful they’ve got mine, too! [ ]Wisconsin Laborers’ District Council And finally, I got to meet with medical students in Wauwatosa to discuss reproductive freedom and my work to restore and expand protections for Wisconsin women. We talked about the implications of the Dobbs decision in states with restrictive abortion laws like ours, and the students got to share their stories about how it has affected them. I’m going to keep doing everything I can in the Senate to defend abortion rights in our state and nationwide. [ ]Wauwatosa There’s nothing I enjoy more than traveling the state and meeting with the folks I was elected to represent. It’s the most important part of the job, and it’s all made possible thanks to members of this grassroots team — that’s YOU! Friend,

We are in the midst of a massive affordability crisis.

Total debt for US households just passed $17 trillion—the highest it’s ever been. That includes $1.6 trillion in student loans; $1 trillion in credit card debt, with interest rates topping at 25%; and $195 billion in medical debt.

Household debt is preventing everyday folks from living a good life. It makes investing in the future—buying a home, raising a family, saving for retirement—feel out of reach for so many. That’s why we need bold action. We need Congress to cancel student debt up to $50,000 for working and middle-class Americans, eliminate medical debt, and cap credit card interest rates before we crater the economy.

Sign the petition: Congress must tackle the affordability crisis. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/affordability-crisis-petition?contactdata=jbwnkM13/YC2q7kEXqwrGNushP7sLkCeE7gUMguf6u4I9ywx2oyjaXMzoaD2irHKuiovdEwW2QfCaGrMmDxMwuXQazlRhmH51/vAN6HkPU/D99SOdphIJlPcCVk4T7taVei1svdjcb2SPOXzIz2Ihg==]

Peter,
Josh Hawley did more than just prove that he’s a fraud and a coward on January 6th. **He made himself the most vulnerable GOP senator up for re-election in 2024.**

[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/36603?refcode=em20230920-3813&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3813%2E614464%2EChAe1g)
**Almost all of Josh Hawley’s support base has abandoned him** — and a recent report from _Morning Consult_ showed that he has the lowest approval rating of ANY GOP U.S. senator running for re-election in 2024.
**That gives us a real opportunity to defeat Hawley and take Missouri’s Senate seat back for working people next year, but it's not going to be easy.**

If these are the kind of resources they’re willing to spend in the off-year, it’s only a matter of time before they start spending _even more_ to ramp up their attacks. **And with a new poll showing Hawley in a dead heat with Lucas Kunce, we can’t afford to take our foot off the gas.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/36603?refcode=em20230920-3813&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=3813%2E614464%2EChAe1g)

And since Lucas isn’t taking a cent from corporate PACs, we’re relying on your help to make it happen, Peter.
**[So please, will you rush a donation of $10 or whatever you can afford to our grassroots movement to elect Lucas Kunce? Our best shot at building a winning campaign is keeping up our record-breaking momentum — and that’s only possible with your support.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/36603?refcode=em20230920-3813&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=3813%2E614464%2EChAe1g)**

The New York Times is so ubiquitous in our media landscape, that it’s often called the “newspaper of record.”

**ATTORNEY GENERAL GARLAND AND FBI DIRECTOR WRAY SUED BY J-6 PEACEFUL PROTESTERS OVER ILLEGAL SURVEILLANCE**
_Class Action Could Result in Prosecutions and Convictions Being Thrown Out_ _**Over One Billion USD in Jury Award Requested**_ (Northern District of Florida, September 20, 2023). Today, Larry Klayman, Esq., the founder of both Freedom Watch and Judicial Watch, and now the Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, announced the filing of a class action lawsuit against Biden Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray and their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice, for ordering and carrying out illegal surveillance concerning the peaceful protesters of January 6, 2021 (hereafter ‘J-6’) , prohibited under Section 702 of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act. The class action complaint, styled _Rivera et. al v. FBI et. al, Civil Action No. 3:23-CV-24547_ was filed before the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Florida and requests an award of over a Billion USD to the January 6, 2021 victims of this illegal surveillance. That this illegal surveillance occurred and was trained on J-6 peaceful protesters is not in dispute and has been widely disclosed and reported upon by major news organizations. Previously, in a case styled Klayman v. Obama et. al, Civil Action No.1:13-CV-00851 (D.D.C. 2013), Klayman had previously obtained preliminary injunctions against the Obama-Biden NSA when it was revealed by Edward Snowden that identical mass surveillance had been illegally conducted against hundreds of millions of Americans. A copy of the class action complaint is embedded below and can be viewed at [www.freedomwatchusa.org](https://freedomwatchusa.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=72bc9b8de1fa17e6901eb23e7&id=0ac65bb500&e=8edd2b8f7d). Klayman had this to say when filing the class action complaint: “This case has the potential not just to yield large damages for the J-6 victims of the illegal surveillance by the Biden Department of Justice and its criminally minded attorney general and FBI director, but also to potentially knock out the prosecutions and convictions of J-6 peaceful protesters, as it appears that evidence was illegally obtained to use against them.” “Attorney General Merrick Garland, a pliant tool of the Democrat anti-Trump Left and President Biden himself, and his ‘lackey’ of an FBI Director Christopher Wray, have no respect for the constitutional rights of J-6 defendants and they will be made to pay a heavy price for their illegal actions.” “These two dishonest and corrupt ‘public servants’ have sadly turned my once proud alma mater, the U.S. Department of Justice, into a virtual Gestapo to put down all dissent against President Biden and his leftist comrades. This cannot be permitted to continue without legal recourse.” **For further information contact Asher Anderson at Asher.andersonfw@gmail.com**

name: Deya at United We Dream Action
subject: Last week, Judge Hanen ruled against DACA. Again.
body:
DACA was never enough. | | | Last week, Judge Hanen ruled against DACA yet again and doubled down on his decision to halt new applications. We’ve been anticipating this decision for months but didn’t know when it would come. Once it did, this community sprung into action — sharing critical information for DACA recipients, running rapid response digital ads, and flooding elected officials with letters from constituents demanding action on a pathway to citizenship. Ayanna Pressley, and dozens of other members of Congress to call on President Biden to do more in the push to cancel student debt. He can and must use additional tools to cancel student debt, address the rising cost of college, and make higher education affordable for people at all income levels. Black women are uniquely and disproportionately burdened by student debt. In order to reduce the racial wealth gap and advance a just and equitable economy for all, we must alleviate the burden of student debt. With love, Cori Paid for by Cori Bush for Congress | | Sent via . To update your email address, change your name or address, or to stop receiving emails from Cori Bush for Congress, please .

Friends,
I have a front-row seat to the disorganization and extremism that is the House GOP, so I can tell you without a doubt that if we want to make progress in our government, Democrats must take back the House in 2024.
We should all hope and aim to work across the aisle and find areas of common ground to serve our constituents, no matter which party is in power. But today’s Republican Party is only interested in bipartisanship when they don’t have the upper hand.
So instead of working together to pass meaningful, common-sense legislation, we’re forced to negotiate on the GOP’s extreme demands simply to avoid imminent disaster. Battling unnecessary crises every few months leaves little space to address the things we want most - like protecting abortion rights, tackling the climate crisis, and expanding voting rights.
We can’t rely on reasonable GOP colleagues (and they’re in short supply, anyway). We need to secure a Democratic majority.
I’m going to fight tooth and nail to hold onto my own seat against a Republican who thinks climate change is a hoax and wants to overturn marriage equality - but I want to do more.
If I can build up enough resources, I’ll have the opportunity to support my fellow Democrats who are facing similarly extreme MAGA opponents - and that will mean a lot in our fight for progressive priorities.
I know this team is capable of helping me build a movement to get this done. Will you pitch in today? Your donation will help me hold my seat and support other Democrats in difficult races. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]

Neither Jim Jordan nor Kevin McCarthy believe a word of the drivel that comes out of their mouths. name: Aaron Regunberg
subject: You're invited to a campaign debrief with WFP
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Aaron Regunberg for Congress
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/105362/images/Aaron_logo_full-color_no-frame.png]

Dear Peter,

As you know, our campaign is over, so I’m almost done sending you emails like this.

But I wanted to reach out one more time, to make one more plug!

I’m really proud of the race we ran, and the thing I’m proudest of (and most grateful about) is all the incredible people who came together to volunteer, organize, and support our campaign in other grassroots ways.

Though the election didn’t end the way we’d hoped, our movement can’t afford to let that collective energy fade away. So I’m writing with one last ask: If you, like me, want to continue building the infrastructure we need to win a livable future, a fair economy, and a government that works for all of us, I hope you’ll consider becoming a member of the Working Families Party.

» Click here to RSVP for Monday's election debrief call with me and the RI Working Families Party. [https://www.mobilize.us/ri-wfp/event/580474/]

The Working Families Party was a key part of our campaign. But more importantly, it’s an organization that works 365 days a year to do what our campaign, with your help, was striving to do — build the movement we need to take on corporate power and push the Democratic Party to be the best version of itself that it can be.

I know that all you beautiful people who phone banked, knocked on doors, and made grassroots contributions to our campaign weren’t doing it just to support me — you were investing in our shared hope for a future where our climate and our health and our collective prosperity are valued more highly than corporate profits. That’s the same future WFP is fighting for, and getting involved in WFP is one great way to continue investing in our shared hope.

So I wanted to invite you to a Zoom call this Monday, September 25th at 5:30pm with RIWFP where you can learn more about the organization and ways to get involved . We’ll also be getting the gang back together to do a bit of a debrief on the campaign and share our analysis and lessons learned from this process (and I’d love to hear your thoughts, too).

Click here to RSVP for Monday's call:
https://www.mobilize.us/ri-wfp/event/580474/ [https://www.mobilize.us/ri-wfp/event/580474/]

Thanks again for joining me on this ride. Our work is just beginning, and I’m so very grateful to continue fighting alongside you.

Best,
Aaron

P.S.: If you're not in Rhode Island, you can still get involved with the Working Families Party by signing up here. [https://act.workingfamilies.org/forms/sign-the-wfp-peoples-charter-and-become-a-wfp-supporter/?source=Regunberg]

DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ar_prog?refcode=9/7]

clean_body: A note from the Campaign Tail 🐾 | | | | Hey Peter, it's Sila, the big sister of the Peterson Pack. That's me, on the far right, smiling at the camera. Focused. Present. I know how to show up for a photo. The one who looks like a toy polar bear is my kid sister, Elsa. And the two guys on the ground are my brothers, T.K. and Nukka. They think it's funny to stick their tongues out for photos. 🙄 = Mom's been in public service for my whole life. That means I've had a lot of photo ops. And I learned early on that when the camera's out, you need to pay attention. See, when I was just a little pup, I came to mom's events. And at one of them, I was listening to her talk about stuff like "affordable housing, transportation, the economy" when I caught a whiff of something...delicious. Savory? With a hint of sweetness? Could it be ...ham? I know what you're thinking: "why would there be ham at a press conference?" I was thinking the same thing. But, when I caught that whiff the other day, I started looking around and HAM-BAM there it was! = You gotta stay vigilant about snacks. Somebody must've been eating a breakfast burrito, because the most beautiful little bit of ham was gleaming on the floor in front of mom. I was fixated, and that'swhen they decided to take my picture!? As if I hadn't been dutifully listening to mom for like six minutes before that?! Unbelievable. My brothers still won't let me forget about it. = Donate Now If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = ---|--- = | = = I want to prove that this is actually a good dog photo by fundraising a bit — and I promise I won't beg that we spend it on ham. Things like voter outreach and campaign operating costs and dog-knocking and maybe ham. Woof! Sila | | | Paid for by Lynn Peterson for Congress |

body:
| Peter Willis,

**Our Revolution is endorsing Barbara Lee to be the next U.S. Senator from California!**

We announced our endorsement LIVE last night at a **major town hall event** , joined by U.S. Reps. **Pramila Jayapal, Ro Khanna, Cori Bush, Mark Pocan, Ayanna Pressley** , and Minnesota Attorney General **Keith Ellison** -- all rallying behind Barbara!

**Barbara Lee is _the movement candidate_ in this race**. She is a lifelong organizer who doesn’t just talk the talk, she has lived it and been in the trenches with working people from Day 1. She’s been one of the most effective progressives in the country and has stood for what’s right even when she’s had to stand alone.

Many remember Barbara Lee’s lone vote against the War in Afghanistan, and she has been a constant voice for people, peace, and the planet throughout her career.

[](https://act.ourrevolution.com/signup/barbaralee_orgteam_2309/?source=EM_NBI_OR_20230920_PT_bleeendrose_0_6MO_ourrevolution_na_na_bleenedorse&t=11&akid=4689%2E5885482%2EYPqoMF)

[JOIN US IN ORGANIZING FOR BARBARA LEE](https://act.ourrevolution.com/signup/barbaralee_orgteam_2309/?source=EM_NBI_OR_20230920_PT_bleeendrose_0_6MO_ourrevolution_na_na_bleenedorse&t=12&akid=4689%2E5885482%2EYPqoMF)
Barbara Lee comes from the **working class** and was a social worker before entering public service. She would be the **only Black woman in the Senate** , and her lived experience fuels her determination to fight for single moms, abortion rights, economic justice, and more.

While others seek the limelight, Barbara Lee has been doing the right thing for its own sake -- not for personal credit. She’s the least wealthy member of the California delegation. This was never about her, it was always about **getting things done** -- passing over 100 bills during her time in the House and CA Legislature.

Barbara has worked closely with **Bernie Sanders** for many years, they co-founded the Congressional Progressive Caucus -- and they are still progressive partners -- recently introducing a bill together to tax the rich.

She has the **most liberal** voting record in Congress, ranked by GovTrack.us. Barbara Lee was an **original cosponsor of Medicare for All** and the **first to introduce a single payer healthcare bill in CA**. Barbara was also one of the first climate champions -- she’s long opposed **taxpayer-funded giveaways to Big Oil** , and she’s pledged to not take money from the fossil fuels industry. In fact, she’s not taking any corporate PAC money!

Barbara Lee was among the first to the Fight for $15 and a Union, joining Bernie Sanders and Keith Ellison on the picket lines when no one else would stand with them — and she is still fighting alongside them in California, where the restaurant industry is trying to take away rights workers organized and won in 2022.

Barbara Lee leads the Congressional Pro-Choice Caucus, she authored California's **Violence Against Women Act** , and was an early advocate for the LGBTQ community, writing California’s landmark Hate Crimes Reduction Act.

**Let’s elect Barbara Lee to carry on this fight and bring our progressive movement with her to the U.S. Senate!**

_“Our Revolution has empowered people in every corner of this country to stand up against corporate greed and restore government to its core function: public service. I am so honored to have earned their endorsement. Together, we will show CA what grassroots power looks like.”_ -- Rep. Barbara Lee
[](https://act.ourrevolution.com/signup/barbaralee_orgteam_2309/?source=EM_NBI_OR_20230920_PT_bleeendrose_0_6MO_ourrevolution_na_na_bleenedorse&t=13&akid=4689%2E5885482%2EYPqoMF)
From conversations with Our Revolution members in California and across the country, it’s clear that Barbara Lee is the progressive movement candidate in this race. That’s why we’ll be organizing for Barbara Lee all the way through Election Day on March 5!

[Sign up to join Progressives for Barbara Lee, and be part of our organizing team to help send Barbara Lee to the U.S. Senate!](https://act.ourrevolution.com/signup/barbaralee_orgteam_2309/?source=EM_NBI_OR_20230920_PT_bleeendrose_0_6MO_ourrevolution_na_na_bleenedorse&t=14&akid=4689%2E5885482%2EYPqoMF)

| | FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Sun Reader,
---
| | In over sixty years in the legal profession, I’ve experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

In today’s media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong. Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

The New York Sun is different. It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don’t agree with everything that can be found in the Sun’s pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I’ve been impressed by the Sun’s growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

The Sun’s success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth. But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don’t wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

I come from a big family of immigrants, farm workers and entrepreneurs. My parents, immigrants who made their way to the Rio Grande Valley from Mexico, did a little bit of everything to make ends meet. But running our flea market, Pulga Los Portales, serving thousands of our community members on a weekly basis and helping dozens of working-class entrepreneurs start their businesses, defined my family's values — our South Texan values.
But my life changed forever when I was in college. While at Columbia University, after years of fighting multiple sclerosis, my mother took her last breath at just 46 years old. It was then I decided the best way to honor her legacy is to fight for a better future for my family.
To fight for a better future for ALL of us.
Every day, I see how hard the people of South Texas work just to scrape by. At our family’s pulga, dozens of vendors come each week, hoping to make enough to put food on the table. They are the overlooked emprendedores who make our community strong.
This fight is personal to me. We need someone who is going to go all-out to strengthen the position of working families — and Monica De La Cruz has proven time and again that she does not represent working families in Congress.
Hard working South Texans deserve an economy that works for them, not only for the people at the top. When I’m in Congress, that’s exactly what I’ll fight for.
**[Peter, I’ll never stop fighting for mi gente. But to get to Washington where I can fight to protect working families, I need your support. Will you chip in right now to make sure TX-15 has a representative who will do what it takes to fight for the families of South Texas?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953ySVaDaV5oWUMSiiW973_z_FEv-M5e_GWy6bqP3povHx565hB3noR9Ap2loiAJeADQ3oPdrgDm_W1wYkfa2DnmLAXRXJnzxmSFgaw9XZmwUujJ0Jodb83hJ-X18aXlRK4H1Fznu5dW1B2xnJLVykK5R7A2Rqczdr8BV7j6nsEl8SBZdC77w4zx-kdVMJVWEasUvHYyOTPKUrDUBlFhkwfbNBKfK0aUlOYmLlFq3Kse2zVuk82TmnRaLbi3ETKh_WqotSzB8ovVDxCCr_XXESrE0oAHMaqH46VPNhFaYdkJ2uUJPKas9sGpHJrKBJTutYqzy4Rdsz9mq8yMPnj4JVfAq/3zr/xOIVgkm2Rbay0pfFkDEoOg/h8/r6nPIifHEIU0ESzFF68yqG1MFyXThn8Z7nsteIGKe8g)**

clean_body: I’m with you because I’ve been there | | | Peter, every day people ask me why I’m in this fight to represent TX-15. Today, I want to share my “why” with you. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll instantly process your contribution to Michelle Vallejo: | I come from a big family of immigrants, farm workers and entrepreneurs. My parents, immigrants who made their way to the Rio Grande Valley from Mexico, did a little bit of everything to make ends meet. But running our flea market, Pulga Los Portales, serving thousands of our community members on a weekly basis and helping dozens of working-class entrepreneurs start their businesses, defined my family's values — our South Texan values. But my life changed forever when I was in college. While at Columbia University, after years of fighting multiple sclerosis, my mother took her last breath at just 46 years old. It was then I decided the best way to honor her legacy is to fight for a better future for my family. To fight for a better future for ALL of us. Every day, I see how hard the people of South Texas work just to scrape by. At our family’s pulga, dozens of vendors come each week, hoping to make enough to put food on the table. They are the overlooked emprendedores who make our community strong. This fight is personal to me. We need someone who is going to go all-out to strengthen the position of working families — and Monica De La Cruz has proven time and again that she does not represent working families in Congress. Hard working South Texans deserve an economy that works for them, not only for the people at the top. When I’m in Congress, that’s exactly what I’ll fight for. ¡Vamos por Quince! Michelle Vallejo | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Michelle Vallejo for Congress Michelle Vallejo for Congress PO Box 1265 Mission, TX 78573

name: Friends of the Earth
subject: Your Signature is Needed: Don’t let Senator Marshall REVERSE organic farm animal protections
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1999070?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Senator Marshall is proposing an amendment that would _REVERSE_ our work to strengthen organic animal welfare. We cannot let that happen, Friend. [Sign the petition now before it’s too late!](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1999071?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** Friend, environmentalists like you have demanded regulations ensuring _all_ animals on organic farms are treated humanely, which is what most of us expect from USDA Organic. Because of your hard work, the USDA is _so close_ to implementing the**Organic Livestock and Poultry Standard Rule (OLPS)** , which would strengthen animal welfare standards for organic farming, including closing a loophole that allows some producers to **deny organic chickens access to the outdoors! **Organic farmers, advocates and consumers have pushed USDA for decades to finalize these important rules and ensure organic can live up to its vision of building a _healthier, more transparent, and**more humane** food system_. **But Senator Marshall has introduced an amendment that would _BLOCK_ the rule from moving forward!** If it passes, this amendment would remove accountability and strict guidelines that would ensure _**ALL**_ organic farmers have to treat animals humanely. **This is URGENT!** [**The Marshall Amendment could move forward soon Friend if we do not act _FAST_. Sign the petition before 11:59pm TONIGHT to protect organic farm animal welfare>>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1999072?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1999073?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
In 2017, the Trump Administration reversed the OLPS rule, and since then we have been fighting to get the USDA to implement these common sense regulations. The OLPS rule ensures the __humane treatment of animals on organic farms, creates a level playing field for organic farmers__ and gives __consumers the peace of mind__ that they deserve.
Organic farming is better for people and the planet. We need your help to ensure it’s better for _**all**_ animals on organic farms, too. [**We’re short of our goal Friend — we need 1,914 more signatures to STOP Senator Marshall from blocking crucial regulations that would support animal welfare standards and maintain consumer trust. Will you add your name NOW to speak up for organic farm animals, farmers, and consumers?>>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1999074?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1999075?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Jane Fonda here.

I wanted to take a moment between events at Climate Week to share some big news with you, and express gratitude to California Governor Gavin Newsom for his recent decision to sue Big Oil for the harm they’ve caused to our communities.

For far too long, the fossil fuel industry lied to our communities about burning planet-warming fossil fuels and its consequences to our planet. As a result, extreme heat waves, floods, drought, and wildfires across the continent are affecting vulnerable frontline communities at an unprecedented rate.

Thankfully, Governor Newsom understands that the climate crisis is actually a fossil fuels crisis. Earlier this week, I had a chance to thank him in person for his leadership on this issue.

From: Josh Shapiro
Subject: Pennsylvania is now an Automatic Voter Registration state
Date: September 19, 2023
Derek, I’m so proud to share this news with you:
**This morning, I announced that Pennsylvania is now an automatic voter registration state!**
From now on in Pennsylvania, if you’re a legal, eligible voter getting or renewing your driver’s license or ID card at the DMV, _you will be automatically registered to vote_ unless you choose to opt out.
This will help tens of thousands of Pennsylvanians make their voice heard – no matter who you choose to vote for or what your views are.
When I ran for Governor, I promised that I'd defend our democracy and secure our fundamental freedom to vote. **And by bringing automatic voter registration home to Pennsylvania — the birthplace of our democracy – we’re making that promise a reality.**
[_**Derek, this would not be possible without you and the thousands of people who chipped in, volunteered and voted last year. And as we take this monumental step to strengthen our democracy, I’m asking for your continued support. Will you chip in a few dollars today to continue the fight for our democracy?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70062067/428209378/-1162444457?refcode=email_092023_Voter-registration-kicker&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MjM2MTIxOC1mYTU3LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BrHdqGbV3zoSs775udgQQcoVPuoJSgk8pW5D-QcvpjM=)
Free and fair elections are the cornerstone of our democracy, and automatic voter registration is a commonsense step to make our elections more secure and save Pennsylvanians time and money.
I will never stop fighting to make government work for the people and bring real freedom to every Pennsylvanian, and I’m so proud to take this historic step forward today to strengthen our democracy for years to come.
Thank you for being in this fight,
Josh

From: Nikki Budzinski
Date: Tuesday, September 12, 2023
Subject: Seeking help can be difficult
Friend,
Every September, we recognize Suicide Prevention Awareness Month, as suicide is the tenth leading cause of death in the United States and the second leading cause of death among young adults between the ages of 10 and 34.
For those living with mental illness, seeking help can still be incredibly difficult given the barriers and stigma associated with mental health, which can often be even more challenging for young adults.
That’s why earlier this year, I was proud to co-introduce the _Trauma Support and Mental Health in Schools Reauthorization Act_ — bipartisan legislation to improve access to evidence-based trauma support and mental health care services for students across our country.
I understand the mental health struggles communities across our district and country are facing, and that’s why I’m working with my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to raise awareness and pass common-sense legislation to help address the stigma that prevents young adults from seeking help.
By passing this legislation, we will increase awareness of mental health issues among students, train school personnel to detect and respond to mental health issues and connect students to the critical services they need.
[**Friend, please support my efforts to pass this life-changing bipartisan legislation by signing my petition to call on Congress to pass the Trauma Support and Mental Health in Schools Reauthorization Act and address this public health crisis.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70062146/428209717/1335628165?refcode=AU_NJB_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20230920_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNTU2OWZmMy1mYTU3LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WyQxPpVi97p-8PVi4CYlznnrupWpQYOLA8PoPgNNS_s=&emci=864a56ea-fa57-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=b5569ff3-fa57-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=13891387)

body:
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=702%2E552475%2EJ_pX8J)
Hi Peter, it's Terese Casey. I'm writing to you today to tell you about my husband Bob and the person I've known for more than forty years as he runs for re-election.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230920-2?refcode=em20230920-2&refcode2=702_552475_J_pX8J&akid=702%2E552475%2EJ_pX8J)
Bob and I met in college before marrying and building our lives here in Scranton, where Bob grew up. We have lived in the same home since 1991, where we raised our four daughters Elyse, Caroline, Julia, and Marena and where our two grandsons, Max and Aiden visit often with “Bomba and Mimi".
Whether it was coaching basketball games, imagining the most elaborate bedtime stories for the girls, or being the constant cameraman for all our home videos, he always showed up for our family with love, joy, compassion, and humor.
It's those same qualities that Bob has brought to his work as a Senator for our Commonwealth every single day. Nobody cares more about improving the lives of Pennsylvanians than he does. I've seen firsthand just how hard he fights for families like ours in the Senate.
Don't just take it from me. All you have to do is look at his record to know why we need him in the Senate. He's worked to bring jobs back to our state, lower costs for our seniors and those with disabilities, make childcare more affordable, and more.
But the reality is, this re-election campaign won't be easy. In fact, it might be our toughest one yet. That's why I wanted to reach out today, to ask you if you'd join our team and help make sure Bob wins this race.
**[If you're able, will you donate $5 or more to support Bob's re-election efforts? Bob and I couldn't be more grateful for the support of every person who chips in, no matter the amount.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230920-2?refcode=em20230920-2&refcode2=702_552475_J_pX8J&akid=702%2E552475%2EJ_pX8J)**
**[Donate Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230920-2?refcode=em20230920-2&refcode2=702_552475_J_pX8J&akid=702%2E552475%2EJ_pX8J)**
I've watched Bob make the early morning and late night trips down to Washington or across the Commonwealth, to all 67 counties, from our home in Scranton day after day, year after year. Bob is a true Pennsylvanian and no one works harder for the people of this Commonwealth than he does. Thank you for stepping up so he can keep serving our state.
Thank you,
Terese

* * *
To receive texts from Team Casey text TEAM to 51041. This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://go.bobcasey.com/signup/receive-fewer-emails/?t=2&akid=702%2E552475%2EJ_pX8J)

name: Aaron Regunberg
subject: Corrected date! You're invited to a campaign debrief with WFP
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Aaron Regunberg for Congress
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/105362/images/Aaron_logo_full-color_no-frame.png]

Apologies for the double-send, but correction: this call is actually Monday, October 2nd at 5:30pm.

###

Dear Peter,

As you know, our campaign is over, so I’m almost done sending you emails like this.

But I wanted to reach out one more time, to make one more plug!

I’m really proud of the race we ran, and the thing I’m proudest of (and most grateful about) is all the incredible people who came together to volunteer, organize, and support our campaign in other grassroots ways.

Though the election didn’t end the way we’d hoped, our movement can’t afford to let that collective energy fade away. So I’m writing with one last ask: If you, like me, want to continue building the infrastructure we need to win a livable future, a fair economy, and a government that works for all of us, I hope you’ll consider becoming a member of the Working Families Party.

» Click here to RSVP for Monday October 2nd's election debrief call with me and the RI Working Families Party. [https://www.mobilize.us/ri-wfp/event/580474/]

The Working Families Party was a key part of our campaign. But more importantly, it’s an organization that works 365 days a year to do what our campaign, with your help, was striving to do — build the movement we need to take on corporate power and push the Democratic Party to be the best version of itself that it can be.

I know that all you beautiful people who phone banked, knocked on doors, and made grassroots contributions to our campaign weren’t doing it just to support me — you were investing in our shared hope for a future where our climate and our health and our collective prosperity are valued more highly than corporate profits. That’s the same future WFP is fighting for, and getting involved in WFP is one great way to continue investing in our shared hope.

So I wanted to invite you to a Zoom call on Monday, October 2nd at 5:30pm with RIWFP where you can learn more about the organization and ways to get involved . We’ll also be getting the gang back together to do a bit of a debrief on the campaign and share our analysis and lessons learned from this process (and I’d love to hear your thoughts, too).

Click here to RSVP for the call on Monday October 2nd:
https://www.mobilize.us/ri-wfp/event/580474/ [https://www.mobilize.us/ri-wfp/event/580474/]

Thanks again for joining me on this ride. Our work is just beginning, and I’m so very grateful to continue fighting alongside you.

Best,
Aaron

P.S.: If you're not in Rhode Island, you can still get involved with the Working Families Party by signing up here. [https://act.workingfamilies.org/forms/sign-the-wfp-peoples-charter-and-become-a-wfp-supporter/?source=Regunberg]

DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ar_prog?refcode=9/7]

https://www.facebook.com/aaronregunbergforri [https://www.facebook.com/aaronregunbergforri] https://twitter.com/aaronregunberg [https://twitter.com/aaronregunberg] http://aaronregunberg.com [http://aaronregunberg.com]

Aaron Regunberg for Congress
50 Duncan Avenue, Providence RI 02906

Paid for by Aaron Regunberg for Congress
Hillary Salmons, Treasurer

body:
Hi Peter,
As you might know this past summer has been dubbed the hot strike summer . From the studios in Hollywood to the factories in Detroit, working folks are fed up with out-of-date contracts and falling wages while executives give themselves millions in pay raises.
Strong unions build up a strong middle class. That's why I support our friends in labor as they fight for fairer wages and improved working conditions. I'm forwarding you an email I wrote on Labor Day talking about my history fighting alongside labor.
As your next Congresswomen, I will always fight for working folks in Arizona and all across this country. Can you help me get there? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_092023_laborreup]
A ganar,
Raquel
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Raquel Terán <info@raquelteran.com>
Date: Mon, Sep 4, 2023 at 9:30AM
Subject: Honoring Labor
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_092023_laborreup [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_092023_laborreup]
Peter,
Through my experience as an organizer with Mi Familia Vota, an SEIU civic participation program, and working for UFCW Local 99 nearly two decades ago, I learned the power of unions.
In Arizona, the Republican extremists have continued to attack our labor movement by trying to stop them from improving working conditions, unionizing, and their efforts to build political power.
And when the same forces gutted our education system and health care and attacked our immigrant communities, Labor has not shied away. They have collectively worked with our progressive organizations to fight back. To stop the chipping away of our education, protect health care and access to abortions, and push back against the anti-immigrant sentiment.
Never once did our friends in labor say, “those aren’t our fights.” They said, “we have your back.”
We rise on the shoulders of Labor. Who, despite the adversities, have built strong unions.
From construction workers, grocery store workers, and those who respond to crises. Labor has organized their workplace and built political power.
Now we have to seal the deal on the work that has been done by the labor movement and by the young and old knocking on doors in 115-degree weather. We have to seal the deal and break the cycle of poverty and get to a stronger middle class -- because the other side won’t do it for us. It’s up to us.
We have to retake the majority in Congress and protect our majority in the Senate. We have to re-elect President Biden, and support progressives at the state and local level here in Arizona too.
We are stronger than we’ve ever been. We are more than allies -- we are family -- and we can get this done! Thank you!
Happy Labor Day,
Raquel Terán

body:
Now that I’ve been in Congress for nine months, I wanted to take a moment and reach out personally to let you know what serving Northeast Ohio – my beloved home – means to me and give you an update on the state of our race.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70064219/428215988/-1741698823?refcode=em_fr_2023.09.20_b1_es_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NTEyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMjRlYTA3My0wMTU4LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yWw7ak28V_C6dcUYnwbDq2LtAhLQC8cI8q9VKkbxdyA=) Hi Peter, it’s Emilia.

Now that I’ve been in Congress for nine months, I wanted to take a moment and reach out personally to let you know what serving Northeast Ohio – _my beloved home_ – means to me and give you an update on the state of our race.

_(But before I do, I have to ask: At the end of the month, my team faces yet another challenge as we reach the end of the fundraising quarter.[**The success of our team this month will directly impact the success of our team next November, so will you please consider chipping in $5 to help our team end September on a strong note?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70064220/428215989/-1741698823?refcode=em_fr_2023.09.20_b1_es_all-nd&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NTEyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMjRlYTA3My0wMTU4LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yWw7ak28V_C6dcUYnwbDq2LtAhLQC8cI8q9VKkbxdyA=))_

**Simply put: I know how hard the people of Northeast Ohio work because I’ve seen it all my life.**

Growing up in Akron, I quickly learned that working families throughout our community aren’t given the same opportunities or a level playing field that others enjoy. **And that’s exactly why I entered a career in public service, Peter: To change the status quo.**

That’s why I worked across the aisle in the Ohio House to fight for higher wages, working and middle-class tax cuts, and other legislation that would put more money in the pockets of Northeast Ohioans. And that’s why, last year, I ran for – _and won_ – one of the most competitive House seats in the country – despite all of the pollsters counting out our scrappy grassroots team.

_Our community deserves a fierce advocate on the federal level_ – someone who isn’t afraid to stand up to people who are standing in the way of progress; someone who will advocate for our jobs, healthcare, and freedoms; and someone who will work to make the day to day a little bit easier. **And that’s exactly what I’m trying to do, every day, in Washington.**

Peter, my promise to you is that I’ll always strive to be that type of leader, and that I’ll never stop fighting for the community I love. **_And when it comes to fighting for Northeast Ohio, I’m only just getting started._**

**But with our district being the most competitive in Ohio – _and one of the most competitive in the entire nation_ – I’m going to need your help to ensure I can keep pushing for progress in Washington.**

[**Please, is there any amount you can pitch in to our people-powered campaign today? It’s no secret that extremist Republicans have been scheming to undermine our elections, but now, they’re doing it right in front of us.
The GOP-controlled Wisconsin Senate voted to fire the state’s top elections official, Wisconsin Elections Commission Administrator Meagan Wolfe.
_Why?_ Wolfe has been the target of vicious conspiracy theories from election deniers who have falsely claimed she was part of a plan to rig the 2020 election.
In the face of danger, Wolfe refused to back down and did everything in her power to protect Wisconsin’s elections. But now -- three years later -- extremists have taken control of the Wisconsin Senate and voted to FIRE her.

name: Katie Porter
subject: Trained healthcare professionals should respond to people experiencing a mental health crisis.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=30187%2E3422442%2E5EQ2Ui)
Having a mental illness is not a crime.
That’s why I introduced the **Mental Health Justice Act.** If enacted, trained healthcare professionals would respond to folks experiencing a mental health crisis rather than police. [**Can you quickly add your name in support of this legislation?**](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/kp4s-em-mental-health-justice/?source=EMAL20_1_LEG_20230920_V1_F&t=2&akid=30187%2E3422442%2E5EQ2Ui)
[Add your name ›››](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/kp4s-em-mental-health-justice/?source=EMAL20_1_LEG_20230920_V1_F&t=3&akid=30187%2E3422442%2E5EQ2Ui)
Just like if you were having a heart attack, you’d want an ambulance and a hospital—if you’re experiencing a mental health crisis, you should receive proper care from trained mental healthcare professionals.
Roughly a quarter of the people who are killed by law enforcement are experiencing a mental health crisis at the time. We can’t address police violence without talking about mental health.
I won’t BS you, the unfortunate reality is that with Kevin McCarthy and Republicans holding the House majority, this bill doesn’t have much of a chance at becoming law this year. But these are the types of bills I’ll champion in the Senate, and through California _alone_ we can flip a handful of MAGA-held seats and give Democrats the House majority.
[**Sign on to show your support for making mental health and legislation like this a real priority.**](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/kp4s-em-mental-health-justice/?source=EMAL20_1_LEG_20230920_V1_F&t=4&akid=30187%2E3422442%2E5EQ2Ui)

Katie

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70065126/428218998/938567526?refcode=header&noskip=true&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NDYxZDM0My0wNTU4LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9IJzs-gySX6WcoyWja3UekljgMuECvR6VTqkYRRb6iY=)
Friends —
Over the past few weeks, the House GOP has been in utter disarray and has done the same for our government.
The far-right has been holding the government hostage, threatening a government shutdown if their demands like defunding the Justice Department (and their investigation into Donald Trump) are not met.
But that’s not all.
**They have also blackmailed Kevin McCarthy into launching an impeachment inquiry into President Biden — threatening to remove him as Speaker if he does comply.**
The MAGA GOP is abusing its power. They are willing to sacrifice the needs of the American people to fuel their political motivations. The only purpose of these stunts is to protect and reelect Trump. And it's clear, they will do everything they can to get Trump back into office.
It should not be this easy for people like Marjorie Taylor Greene and Matt Gaetz to be able to hold the government hostage. While people’s livelihoods are at stake, they sit back and watch their MAGA agenda unfold.
So myself and other House Democrats have called on Kevin McCarthy to put aside partisan politics and protect our economy and the livelihoods of the American people. We can protect working families today with a simple up-or-down vote to authorize funding the government.
[**If you are with us, join me in calling on Speaker McCarthy to stop this MAGA-sponsored government shutdown.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70065129/428219000/-1794131472?refcode2=5461d343-0558-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&refcode=em230920-1-t2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NDYxZDM0My0wNTU4LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9IJzs-gySX6WcoyWja3UekljgMuECvR6VTqkYRRb6iY=&emci=a241ebfc-0058-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=5461d343-0558-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=16877361)

National Public Lands Day is coming up this week — and it’s a critical reminder that we should be working to preserve our public lands and waters every day of the year.
In New Mexico, we have woven public lands into the fabric of our lives. I have spent countless hours with my family hiking, camping, fishing, and hunting on our lands and waters.
**I am fighting in the Senate every day to protect and celebrate our public lands and waters — for my sons and future generations.**
That’s why I am proud to sponsor legislation like the _Simplifying Outdoor Access for Recreation Act_ to simplify our complicated recreational permitting process so that it’s easier to enjoy our beautiful public lands, and the _Recovering America's Wildlife Act_ to invest in the protection of at-risk species and public lands.

clean_body: We need your help to ensure that Bernie Moreno's voice is heard and his America First message resonates across Ohio and the nation. | | Fellow conservative, Washington has enough politicians, it's time for something new. During my time in the Trump administration, I saw first-hand corrupt officials on the Left create a way to systematically destroy our country. We need fresh, conservative, outsiders and leaders in the Senate to undo that damage and set the America First movement back on course. Leaders with integrity, vision, and fight. Bernie Moreno is one of those leaders, I'm proud to endorse Bernie Moreno, and help position him for victory in what will be one of the most competitive Senate races in 2024. Bernie is a staunch supporter of the America First movement. He's driven by a deep belief in the promise of this great nation. His dedication to preserving our constitutional rights, strengthening our economy, and safeguarding our national security is unwavering. His family moved to the U.S. when he was five because they believed in the American Dream, and he knows that it's at risk. Now, he has a steadfast commitment to putting America first and preserving that dream. We need your help to ensure that Bernie Moreno's voice is heard and his America First message resonates across Ohio and the nation. Thank you, Kash Patel Meet Bernie Moreno: | Bernie Moreno fights for the American dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18. Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America. In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First. Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has. Friend,

One of my top priorities as Mayor is standing up for the most vulnerable people in our community. Our team is always working to increase affordable housing and protect the rights of seniors, working families, and people with disabilities.

Recently, we made a big leap forward on that front with the passage of Assembly Bill 1620, an initiative that I spearheaded in partnership with Assemblyman Rick Chavez Zbur.

The bill, which will protect renters in West Hollywood and across the state of California, is a huge win for tenants and disability rights.

It allows renters with a movement disability to switch to an apartment on the first floor of their buildings, while keeping their lease and their rent-stabilized status intact when there is no elevator available. This will make a life-changing difference for seniors and other mobility-challenged tenants, who may have lived and aged for years in an upper-floor apartment with no elevator access.

Friend, I'm a renter too. I know what it's like to struggle to find safe, affordable, accessible housing, and it's a challenge that I don't believe anyone should have to face.

That's why, in the Mayor's office and in Congress, I'll always work to create housing solutions for all of us. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_shyne?refcode=230920_ss_AB1620_l1]
